Peter -
We send a good amount of fundraising emails, and we don’t expect you to give to every one that hits your inbox. But we do hope you’ll give to this one.
Please let us explain why:
**FIRST:** Kari Lake is running for Senate with the full backing of not only the far-right and the MAGA-right, but of the Senate GOP and establishment Republicans around the country.
**THEN:** Kyrsten Sinema is fundraising like she’s running for Senate. She hasn’t slowed down her outreach to the billionaires and hedge-fund managers, which means we have to be ready for her to jump in, too.
**NOW:** After a slow start, we need to hit the ground running this month. With our official FEC deadline approaching on December 31 we need to put out a strong report to show everyone — our allies, our adversaries, and everyone on the fence — that Ruben can win this race and help hold our Senate majority.
If everyone reading this email contributed just $10, we’d reach our goals today and have the resources we need to win this race.
But not everyone does give. Which is why we need people who understand the stakes of this race; who understand how important this Senate race is; who understand how important grassroots donations are to our campaign — to chip in.

We’re mighty proud to have Senator Cassidy representing the Pelican State,**** Friend.
Just days after the October 7th terror attacks in Southern Israel – Senator Cassidy was on the ground in Tel Aviv meeting with Israeli Prime Minister Bibi Netanyahu and his war cabinet.
When radical elements of the Left attempted to whitewash Hamas’ barbaric attacks – Senator Cassidy was quick to offer his unwavering support for Israel’s retaliation and make it clear that Israelis had every right to defend themselves.
When college campuses across the U.S. witnessed a sharp increase in anti-Semitic attacks – Senator Cassidy was one of the first Members of Congress to leap into action.
Now, Senator Cassidy has introduced his******Protecting Students on Campus Act of 2024****.**
This legislation not only clarifies students’ existing rights, it empowers students to take action and file civil rights complaints of their own if they fall victim to anti-Semitic violence or harassment on campus.

body:

---
| | Dear Freedom Fighters,

Last week we held a joint Border briefing between the House and Senate. We were able to ask the Yuma County Sheriff Leon N. Wilmot and Cochise County Sheriff Mark Dannels tough questions about the realities along the Border. In 2022, I was one of the few Republicans who voted in favor of funding border security.

Over the years, I have toured the southern Border a few times, including the Nogales, Douglas, Naco, Hereford, and Sierra Vista areas. The last time I was down there I was escorted through the Sierra Vista area with one of Cochise County’s sergeants. I learned about different items the legislature has invested over the years from scope trucks to trail cams to help local law enforcement with illegal crossings and cartel chases. Since every state has become a border state, other states should be sending resources to every Border state to help us invest in every tool to keep our communities safe.

Like you, I gave up on the local news coverage when my kids were little—they are now ages 19 and 21. Thankfully, the Office of the Inspector General releases [reports](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=8e77ff9312&e=a7ab36849c) undertaken to help shine a light on what is really going on within Homeland Security since the mainstream media isn’t covering the massive illegal immigration surge on our southern border. Prior to me arriving back at the Capitol, Hobbs did away with the line item to fund border security in last year’s budget appropriations.

Lately, I have been fielding a lot of questions from families and schools about the status of Arizona’s scholarship tuition organization (STO) tax credit program and the universal Empowerment Scholarship Account (ESA) program. As you know, I have fought for all school choice options since the 1990s. One of my first jobs during graduate school was working at The Heritage Foundation on the [No Excuses](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=8dc2e5a41a&e=a7ab36849c) project. Back then, school choice was more of a bipartisan issue. Sadly, it has become hyper partisan over the years. In Arizona, more than 73 thousand kids have been approved to receive an ESA as of last week. In addition, nearly 70 thousand kids received a scholarship tuition organization (STO) tax credit scholarship during the 2021-2022 school year.

The House and Senate Republican caucuses are adamantly opposed to Hobbs’s desire to wipe out Arizona’s school choice programs, including our amazing charter schools. Hobbs lit a fire when she said she wanted to the cut the state’s popular ESA and STO programs. Good thing for the time being her plan is dead on arrival. Let me be clear: Hobbs can’t curb the eligibility for these private school programs. We will reject her proposals and block any attempt to regulate the successful universal ESA program and her plan to eliminate the longstanding constitutional and popular subscribed STO tax credit programs. In the meantime, please [send a message to Hobbs](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=d22dce8d6f&e=a7ab36849c) to let her know how much you support our school choice options in Arizona. Then, [find your legislators](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=a751636fb2&e=a7ab36849c) and email them a similar positive message about your support for school choice in Arizona.

It's an honor to serve and to protect our children, school choice and our freedoms. But I need your help today to maintain the majority. As you may know, I returned to the legislature to help uphold our very slim GOP majority. If we lose the majority in November 2024, school choice will die, but it doesn’t end there. If the Democrats gain control of the legislature, they will go after our pro-life laws, universal ESAs, homeschooling, scholarship tuition organization tax credits, parental rights, our low flat tax, gun rights, pro-family values legislation, pro-growth policies, and so much more.

Please don’t sit on the sidelines because saving our Republic is too important when we have an out-of-control federal government and a wide-open southern border. As you know I was appointed to fill a vacancy in my legislative district at the end of July. I also happen to represent a swing district, again. If the Democrat beats me in November 2024, there is a good chance we will lose the entire legislature.

I look forward to earning your support. Please take a moment to visit my [website](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=b3177e93d5&e=a7ab36849c) to learn more about me, and then, please consider making a [donation](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=800f6848a0&e=a7ab36849c) to help us hold on to the majority. I cannot win this race without you. Thanks again for your past support!

Take care,
---

---
| P.S. Last night I joined countless families and all types of schools around Arizona to help kick-off National School Choice Week. Our kids are most important resource, and they are worth saving! I look forward to you joining me in this incredible fight.

Prior to me arriving back at the Capitol, Hobbs did away with the line item to fund border security in last year’s budget appropriations. Lately, I have been fielding a lot of questions from families and schools about the status of Arizona’s scholarship tuition organization (STO) tax credit program and the universal Empowerment Scholarship Account (ESA) program. As you know, I have fought for all school choice options since the 1990s. One of my first jobs during graduate school was working at The Heritage Foundation on the project. Back then, school choice was more of a bipartisan issue. Sadly, it has become hyper partisan over the years. In Arizona, more than 73 thousand kids have been approved to receive an ESA as of last week. In addition, nearly 70 thousand kids received a scholarship tuition organization (STO) tax credit scholarship during the 2021-2022 school year. The House and Senate Republican caucuses are adamantly opposed to Hobbs’s desire to wipe out Arizona’s school choice programs, including our amazing charter schools. Hobbs lit a fire when she said she wanted to the cut the state’s popular ESA and STO programs. Good thing for the time being her plan is dead on arrival. Let me be clear: Hobbs can’t curb the eligibility for these private school programs. We will reject her proposals and block any attempt to regulate the successful universal ESA program and her plan to eliminate the longstanding constitutional and popular subscribed STO tax credit programs. In the meantime, please to let her know how much you support our school choice options in Arizona. Then, and email them a similar positive message about your support for school choice in Arizona. It's an honor to serve and to protect our children, school choice and our freedoms. But I need your help today to maintain the majority. As you may know, I returned to the legislature to help uphold our very slim GOP majority. If we lose the majority in November 2024, school choice will die, but it doesn’t end there. If the Democrats gain control of the legislature, they will go after our pro-life laws, universal ESAs, homeschooling, scholarship tuition organization tax credits, parental rights, our low flat tax, gun rights, pro-family values legislation, pro-growth policies, and so much more. Please don’t sit on the sidelines because saving our Republic is too important when we have an out-of-control federal government and a wide-open southern border. As you know I was appointed to fill a vacancy in my legislative district at the end of July. I also happen to represent a swing district, again. If the Democrat beats me in November 2024, there is a good chance we will lose the entire legislature. I look forward to earning your support. Please take a moment to visit my to learn more about me, and then, please consider making a to help us hold on to the majority. I cannot win this race without you. Thanks again for your past support! Take care, | | P.S. Last night I joined countless families and all types of schools around Arizona to help kick-off National School Choice Week. Dear
Friend,
Over the
last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have provided
the dominant interpretations, and conflicting visions, of
political and economic freedom. In the past few years, we've seen
a growing trend among young Americans in favor of socialism and
against capitalism.

But do
they truly understand the history and outcomes of socialism and
capitalism?

This is
precisely why we put together this brand new eBook, The History
Of Socialism And Capitalism, from Hoover Institution senior
fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson.

This
eBook consists of two papers-one from each scholar-written in
conjunction with The Human Prosperity Project on Socialism and
Free-Market Capitalism. This project provides objective and
scholarly analyses of free-market capitalism, socialism, and
hybrid systems and provides evidence on the effectiveness of the
various systems on outcomes that affect prosperity and
well-being.

I think
you will find this new eBook particularly important and timely,
given the recent interest in policies that are radical from a US
historical perspective, some of which are advocated by political
leaders.

click here to request your free copy of The History Of Socialism
And Capitalism.

Thanks,
Greg

Abortion in Nevada--
| | | |
---
# Titus Tries to Overturn the Will of the People on Abortion in Nevada
By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
---
Abortion is a settled law in Nevada. A referendum of the people passed it, which means neither the Governor nor the legislature can overturn it. Only the people of Nevada can change it. Like 71% of Americans, the people of Nevada think there should be limits on abortion. In Nevada, those limits are 24 weeks and then the life and health of the mother. Dina Titus ignored the will of the people when she voted for a federal law to allow abortion up until the day of delivery and to have the government pay for these unlimited abortions. I support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe vs Wade, not just because I'm pro-life, but because it is the correct legal decision. Even Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg stated that the Roe decision was on shaky legal ground. There is nothing in the Constitution about abortion. When the Constitution is silent on a topic, the power is vested in the States and in "We, the people." The people of Nevada have spoken. As your representative in Congress, I will not support any federal action that goes against the will of the people of my district. In the coming days leading up to the elections, you will hear Titus and others talk about abortion. They will bring it up because they don't want you thinking about inflation, the border crisis, crime, or our failing schools. Remember, the people of Nevada have already spoken on abortion - it is settled law. When career politicians in Nevada bring up abortion, they are just trying to divert your attention from their disastrous policies, which have devastated our country. Don't let them get away with it.
Mark Robertson

*******
---
Your Questions--Mark's Answers
Mark Robertson answers your questions with direct and honest answers. Here are two questions Mark was asked recently:
Q: There have been a number of arrests made, and many participants have been incarcerated for even being present at the Capitol on January 6, 2021. Yet, no such sentences were imposed during much more violent riots, which caused billions of dollars of damages to cities across the country. Do you support similar punishment for violent protestors across the country? -S.T. A. The violence and crime we witnessed by the BLM and defund the police movements were much worse than what happened on January 6th. Those people involved should have been prosecuted and incarcerated just as the January 6th rioters were..
Q. Do you support the use of federal law enforcement agents to police streets in cities with large-scale demonstrations that have sometimes turned violent? -K.L. A. No. The Federal government is already too big and intrusive. State and local law enforcement should respond to these demonstrations. Federal law enforcement should be used to protect Federal facilities like courthouses, federal offices, and military installations.
Please share this message with friends and neighbors. Have questions for me? Simply reply to this email to ask me a question.

| | | Donald Trump was bad enough to begin with, but now he is increasingly showing signs of dementia, most recently [confusing Nancy Pelosi and Nikki Haley](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tae87958e-6184-4b93-a697-ee8e49c3129a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) multiple times in a speech. [**Add your name, and demand that Trump take a mental fitness test from a reliable, independent source, and release the results publicly. **](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta36222d0-575d-408a-be8e-e7a5dfd9dbba/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) The voters have a right to know whether the likely Republican nominee is growing dangerously unhinged from reality. And they need to know before the election. America can't afford to hand the nuclear launch codes to someone who is losing his mind. Nikki Haley has called for him to take such a test, and she is right to do so. ## DeSantis Drops Out of 2024 Race
Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis suspended his 2024 presidential run Sunday, announcing it in a [video on X](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvszAQQH-N2RKdzza2Bw_RF_GpQ7pGnZCBI7mKAMJXov77qu3a7UlveXrXS3vJPPF8e80PSjIube6Fd2r1AfGAtrXVkEYiJFNR0h5cNOhirO4Ja7IDZgi-D-C6QZM2cRxHzD5CBqw4IaAFjajBOaOPuguh853LUAP0wSoLNLAs2_F94VnuNE6fy07bsV8e1ZTuImtR5qSwUdjIk0V-ncJmW-aBSp6Fi8KmSJaPb9DeRu2iCVZrDNZhcMo0RZmzrRXWoszZh5cZ_u3z6um_X69vZ257d6q2NKxPniYutVcWbo_M00-H_HnlKwAA__9m0V6b) just days before Tuesday's New Hampshire primary. He said he would support Donald Trump for president. Polls in New Hampshire show [DeSantis at 6%](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1urDAQQOGnMd2s7MGGpaC4Dd3eNiUyeMAT-QfZzq727aOkTn2ao-_jsT4sB07nfxtpbkde7d74SasCREC96s7NBxFS39GsRmmmHs00dX7ejTMTaj2oYZeGzDDqYdr05jQq67ax4xklaqkQlTSmVze13e_buBkrByn3uxZakuOWy-0zc2qejvDOTyq3PccuzL61q4r-n8BF4NI8eQ7hpwlcfI6U6FUFLruNl-UzCVy0RtlLDY6qTY0rXDmECpygcjoDgeOTW4WNPCcH3gZ6Qytf8QLryTrIByR6gbfxqp4LwVU42vIWuHRldteLQ-A6jELLM1r-venan27fAQAA___shXAE), trailing Nikki Haley's 39% and Donald Trump's 50% support. Voters go to the polls tomorrow, beginning at midnight in the tiny town of Dixville Notch. In his statement, DeSantis said he and his wife saw no good way to move forward after finishing 2nd in Iowa. Once seen as a front-runner, his campaign [struggled for traction](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuhDAQRL_GdKD1YoMpXKShu7Qp0WKWu40MRtg6lL-PSJ1mNMVI8_S-HtODJMr-_KSNfVnTRKHImyddI9ZoJlMtfmVGbiv2ugc7tGiHoXp558AOhC2F2WprNPMaDDow_Wo77qASj4AGNKIGa1vd6Nm5uZ8tQQcQnFEGeJGSzuY7yV5evMaf9OazCWmron-VcmTVfigcFY7XdTVHilIkpHugcNz5ygrH-0XhCPrudyycaS-S65BipCNzfZycZeG9CMU60HaQPPcaQLeds111-uW4JEbJXa8MPDeS-AdR_lXyGwAA__-xrV_5) with personnel turnover, financial issues, and simply an inability to catch fire.

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: there’s a lot going on Pro-Life Friend
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

I know 2024 just started, but I already have a lot to catch you up on!

Between our massive lobbying blitz in January and preparing for our fourth _National Pro-Life Summit,_ _I’ve been SWAMPED_!

But Pro-Life Friend, it’s your generosity that enables all we do.

So, I wanted to send you some updates about what _SFLAction_ has on our plates, so you can see how your generosity is making a big impact.

## _**Pro-Life Generation Lobby Days**
_ _Students for Life Action_ is in the middle of what could be the largest legislative push in the pro-life movement’s history – hosting Lobby Days in 17 different states!

With our massive network of grassroots activists, _Students for Life Action_ just may be the only national organization who can pull this all off – _or even dare to try!_

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sdjhkud-duchtdja-y/) While at each state capital we’re bringing students, staff, and community activists in grassroots mobilization efforts to advance strong pro-life bills.

And Pro-Life Friend, we’re nailing it!

Our students and volunteers are aggressively pushing the _Life at Conception_ and _End Chemical Abortion Acts_ along with the _Heartbeat Abortion Prevention Act_ in several states, including:

***** Kentucky** – Where there’s rumors that Republican leadership is considering weakening the state’s existing Life at Conception law to allow for more abortions.

Needless to say, _SFLAction_ opposes discriminating against any baby due to the circumstances of their conception and changing pro-life laws to allow for more abortion.

***** South Carolina** – Where six “pro-life” state Senators struck down the _Life at Conception Act_ last spring.

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sdjhkud-duchtdja-j/) GOP State Senator Tom Davis and others are continuing to side with the Abortion Lobby, demanding loopholes on abortion you can drive a semi-truck through!

_Students for Life Action_ is returning to the Palmetto State to demand that they finish the job by passing the _Life at Conception Act_ and ending abortion in 2024!

***** Nebraska** – In 2023 State Sen. Merv Riepe single-handedly stopped the Heartbeat Bill from passing. We are continuing to call him to resign so we can push the Heartbeat Bill across the finish line!

One of our legislative interns, Cheyenne Vandeventer had this to say about her recent Lobby Day in Nebraska:

_“A group of 10 students and volunteers came out for the event, and we spent the day delivering stacks of petitions to the Senate Speaker’s office and the Governor’s office. The staff we gave the petitions to at the Governor’s office seemed very supportive of the bill, which was excellent.”_
As we hold our Lobby Days across the country, we’re also dropping a massive door knocking campaign in key districts in February and March.

Pro-Life Friend, these nationwide efforts are critical if we want to show members of BOTH parties we’re serious about saving lives!

## **_Vote Pro-Life First Mobilization Efforts_**
Of course, legislative battles aren’t all that’s happening in 2024, as this election year will also likely prove to be one of the most critical in American history.

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sdjhkud-duchtdja-i/) So, one of our main goals in 2024 is to ensure every pro-lifer votes pro-life!

Sadly, some people who tell us they’re pro-life decide their votes on other issues.

But what could be more important than life or death?

That’s why _Students for Life Action_ has already begun running several programs with an eye on November . . .

These include massive door knocking campaigns and lit drops in key battleground states.

We’ve even planned to host multiple pro-life leadership workshops to mobilize as many people as possible to **Vote Pro-Life First!**

Our hard-working students are going to put in countless hours calling and texting hundreds of thousands of likely pro-life voters urging them to show up to the polls come November.

And we’re not going to wait around until October to do it!

## _**Pregnant Students Rights Act H.R. 6914
_** Of course, it’s not just state legislation and elections _Students for Life Action_ is concerned with.

We want Congress to know we’re insisting they take action to protect life as well!

Just recently, _Students for Life Action_ announced our support for H.R. 6914, the _Pregnant Students Rights Act._

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sdjhkud-duchtdja-d/) The _Pregnant Students Rights Act_ would allow pregnant and parenting students to receive the proper resources they need to thrive while continuing their education, as stated in Title IX laws.

The truth is Pro-Life Friend, far too many colleges and universities have failed its pregnant and parenting students for far too long.

**The great news is, the U.S. House passed this legislation this past Friday – which also happened to be the day of the National Pro-Life March!**

There’s no doubt our presence in Washington, D.C. is making people listen!

The truth is, every pregnant and parenting student deserves to know what resources and accommodations are readily accessible to allow them to pursue their education and career goals.

Pro-Life Friend, your support and generosity are what drive us to continue. It’s what pushes us to ensure Congress is listening to even the smallest of humans – preborn boys and girls.

So please, stand with us as we continue to support these precious preborn babies and their mothers nationwide!

Thank you for your continuous support as we begin 2024!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

**[Donate to _Students for Life Action <<](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sdjhkud-duchtdja-h/)**_

P.S. – I wanted to share a few more photos of our proactive student leaders while at their state capitals lobbying for the pro-life cause:

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sdjhkud-duchtdja-k/)

name: Pro Life Update
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zoe3ovpf99hr6k6abvvpmmnnvrdpv66639o7h788_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm4o71chh2bs) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2ztug66ofndk0h6kq1hdui7sahakmku7ogi9otb90_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm4o71chh2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zn7ps5f518e4vg1t2v0mdcq9ek8bs6lp6jk9vc5g_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm4o71chh2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| Pro Life Update

subject: It’s all coordinated. And it’s all preplanned.

body:
My fellow Americans - this is Mike Johnson.

| |

---
| | | My fellow Americans - this is Mike Johnson.

_**[This is a longer email but I’m humbly asking you to read it start to finish.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zmf6uc7f3qs0badt6f9eah1gn72pljig3gtijhe0_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm4o73cdh2bs "This is a longer email but I’m humbly asking you to read it start to finish.")**_

Why? Because the moment I was elected Speaker by my Republican colleagues, the Radical Left IMMEDIATELY unleashed a coordinated, preplanned political hit job against me.
* The Liberal Media spun up hit piece after hit piece to smear me in the press - Biden’s former Press Secretary even attacked me for being a Christian on MSNBC.
* Politico fired off this headline: _“Democrats rev up the opposition machine against Mike Johnson.”_
* And I can’t even begin to tell you how many Democrat fundraising emails and texts I saw in the minutes following the final vote - I’m bracing myself for the next FEC reports.

Look:

These vicious attacks are a dime a dozen in Washington. They don’t intimidate me. _But I’ll let you in on a little secret: that’s not _really_ the goal..._

The _real_ goal of this political ambush is two-fold: **1)** smear the good names of every House Republican to hurt them electorally, and **2)** scare Liberals enough to whip out their credit cards, fill in their info, and donate to Democrats.

**It’s about power and money. Nothing else.**

That’s why it’s mission-critical that we stand up for ourselves in critical moments like this. _**[So as one of my first moves as Speaker, I’m teaming up with my fellow Louisianian- Majority Leader Steve Scalise - to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zblvhsr0hmd0jtcugf63f6nfa4tojfh2av1iedk8_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm4o73cdh2bs "So as one of my first moves as Speaker, Iâm teaming up with my fellow Louisianian – Majority Leader Steve Scalise – to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.")**_

It’s ambitious. I get it. But that’s the bare minimum we need to fully fund our campaign operations in battleground races across the country.

**If we fall short of that, we’ll be forced to SLASH our voter contact budgets, GUT our digital outreach efforts, and pull our ads OFF THE AIRWAVES. Nothing could be worse for our plans to defend and expand our slim House Majority.**

So here’s my final pitch to you:

We urgently need your help. Not next week, not next month - right here and right now.

The difference between a strong Conservative Majority and one controlled by the Liberal Machine will come down to can’t-miss fundraising goals just like this.

Let me make myself perfectly clear:

_I’m not asking you to pitch in more than you can afford. If you can spare $50 or $100, I would be tremendously grateful. But if you can only spare $5 or $10, I would be equally appreciative._

_**[The ONLY thing I ask is for every Conservative in the country to chip in SOMETHING.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z8a15he51ug91uapumvegbsrm62ckicu5i1q893o_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm4o73cdh2bs "The ONLY thing I ask is for every Conservative in the country to chip in SOMETHING.")**_

That will be the difference between victory and defeat. So what do you say? Can I count you in?
---

---
Thanks for all you do.

In liberty,
Speaker Mike Johnson

We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc18f6757-9c40-4a05-b407-0826e43cef3a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._

| | | | | I have 15 minutes of free time before my next debate prep, Peter. It may not sound like much — but I’ve been working long hours in Congress to avoid a government shutdown, and any gap in my schedule is rare. So, as I’m checking in with my wife, Eve, and catching up on some emails, I’m reflecting on this campaign — the most competitive California has seen in three decades — and I’ve decided I need to tell you a bit more about my decision to run for U.S. Senate. Throughout my time as an assistant U.S. attorney, California state Senator, and member of Congress, I’ve always tried to do the most good for the most people. There is a tenet I’ve carried with me that is central to my Jewish faith — “Tikkun Olam.” Repairing the world. Lately, there’s been a lot that has broken, and a lot to fix. It’s been my cause. It’s why I get up in the morning. When Speaker Nancy Pelosi tasked me with investigating and impeaching Donald Trump. When she asked me to help investigate the Capitol insurrection on the January 6 Committee. I’ve carried that with me. I’ve carried it with me on this campaign, too. People struggling to afford the cost of living and or sending their kids to daycare or college. People struggling to afford their medications. People worrying about what our climate will look like ten, twenty years from now as we are routinely ravaged by drought, mudslides, and wildfires today. Yes, there is a lot that is broken. And there’s a lot to fix. But there’s also a lot of good in the world, too. The people I’ve met on the campaign trail remind me why this work is so important. And the people like you, supporting this campaign a couple bucks at a time, so we can do good work. That’s why I’m running. And now, our primary race is within the margin of error just hours from our first televised debate. It’s critical that we win this race. We need to abolish the filibuster. Expand the Supreme Court. Overturn Citizens United. And protect reproductive freedom. [My 15 minutes are almost up, Peter: I don’t take corporate PAC money, so if you believe in this campaign and want to help me join our Democratic Senate majority and take the fight to Republicans, will you chip in a split $10 between Blue Amp Action and my campaign today?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta036af93-d7f7-4d2b-a994-ec31970733e5/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | About BlueAmp Action: We cannot sugarcoat the current situation. Right-wing authoritarianism, defeated by a worldwide coalition during WWII, was only in hibernation. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! Please follow Cliff Schecter on Twitter @cliffschecter, or subscribe to The Takedown with Cliff Schecter on YouTube, to keep up to date with this battle for the heart and soul of our country. — _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. name: Nikki Haley
subject: Moment to talk?
body:
I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z4ao8eeahq34qgneu8i4b0ltdsdm2t7camu5s8kg_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm6or0sjh2bs)
---

Friend,

Since the moment I got off the stage, I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future.

Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2ztpbr56st0f283vm28kb4ulc0edemil476oe2vg8_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm6or0sjh2bs "Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
---
| | | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zagk2el9c1l53pbe5sifgujsq0vkea7b9coc21cg_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm6or0sjh2bs)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _
---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**
---
| | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zj4iggkourvif2fsgplmkm2r20huuj6k9v7vsnko_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm6or0sjh2bs)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2znrgnf11m084kcjsjl2htepb1fjdppq12q82tqqg_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm6or0sjh2bs)
---

Now, I'm running for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

**[It would mean a lot to me if every single person _reading this today_ could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG! >>](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zb52v3i036j6kimtk48u3omgfsrktkh7u8mgo6g0_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm6or0sjh2bs "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days.

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the strength of OUR movement?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zheo9u3atf1qmrnoj75bj2tb5664nb6fm8f3fpkg_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm6or0sjh2bs "Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the strength of OUR movement?")**

---
| | [RUSH SUPPORT TODAY](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zeguq2006mrg67kjvv0et7lo5b6b476grrfkpkt0_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm6or0sjh2bs)
---

Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, **[I need your help- starting right now.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zrf7s1141ucirm50kj95n0ag01f1quo0bjoh7ouo_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm6or0sjh2bs "I need your help – starting right now. ")**

Your contribution is what keeps this movement alive and thriving, so thank you for standing with me.

My very best,
---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zu2kmt8128rsnrn5smfi94fh8u83fu9qso36rf3o_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm6or0sjh2bs)

---

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zfemr98llrdlhooq340c6slvp1vb4kiltf4or36g_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm6or0sjh2bs "NikkiHaley_Podium")
---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zinj45n0gudv6dcapnt4u56afghes28jav0fk9t8_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm6or0sjh2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

Millions of Americans are besieged today by a sense of civic foreboding. In addition to any number of [social](https://substack.com/redirect/79ac65f1-b31c-4f33-9b48-fe388b8c8151?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [economic](https://substack.com/redirect/4912cdf4-f7f8-477b-a72c-5e6051629313?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) crises that [continue](https://substack.com/redirect/ccc2f1f0-5b95-422c-a1a1-d5a83d4cf842?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to grow [worse](https://substack.com/redirect/29b91df8-6e47-4ee7-8e8d-8d4aaedb73d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with every passing day, they anticipate an [election](https://substack.com/redirect/ad91cfd4-6f74-4a17-9678-92e2f95d0a7f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) later this year in which each of the major parties' candidates have [rejected](https://substack.com/redirect/fc84956b-848b-40b6-b6fb-5ca84c94cdba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) any pretense of respecting democracy.
Depending on the outcome of that election, many liberal observers [fear](https://substack.com/redirect/0441a472-be17-4b49-8b67-3c30a419ef81?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the end of the United States as we know it, or at least the democracy that once inspired the world.
Unfortunately, those voices are too optimistic.
_Help inform your friends!_
[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=140911089&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQwOTExMDg5LCJpYXQiOjE3MDU5Mjk2NTcsImV4cCI6MTcwODUyMTY1NywiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.8ARfOvLDsVo8hnMftEX9CaG0SjoWbqFUGuLcaRomiUg)
In fact, "democracy" in America has never been more than a fantasy.
To fear fascism in the future under a potential second Trump administration overlooks the extent to which fascism has already taken root in the United States--with outrageously bipartisan support.
When the United States was founded, our mechanisms of supposed democracy formally [excluded](https://substack.com/redirect/b0b118b2-c0c3-46d8-8843-385758d727c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) women, racial minorities, and even white men who did not own property. On the one hand, the opportunity to cast votes has [expanded](https://substack.com/redirect/b2f479cf-2d7d-4875-ba66-de65fdee998e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) since then to include [more](https://substack.com/redirect/f4d668df-241e-4d62-bea6-6b5ee64f1a36?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) people, while the [meaning](https://substack.com/redirect/f3fd9387-0e61-4a9d-a7ea-50fcb00024db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and influence of those votes has diminished due to factors ranging from corporate [dominance](https://substack.com/redirect/3dd2d612-ef7a-48d7-a1be-164e59883e90?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of campaign finance and the [entrenchment](https://substack.com/redirect/42ddd9f8-227a-45f5-962c-ca4a25df0c98?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of incumbents to attacks on voting rights and the [loss](https://substack.com/redirect/f3fd9387-0e61-4a9d-a7ea-50fcb00024db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the civil rights movement's signature victories.
Over the past 20 years, in particular, the emergence of fascism in America relied on support from presidents and policymakers who identify as both Republicans and Democrats. Democratic presidents Bill Clinton, Barack Obama, and Joe Biden each played crucial rules ratifying right wing policies that their party had historically opposed.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a791ef8a-0547-49fa-8fc4-bb005dcc0f86?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Beyond representing a historical critique, this post continues an [ongoing](https://substack.com/redirect/fc84956b-848b-40b6-b6fb-5ca84c94cdba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) analysis of the 2024 [election](https://substack.com/redirect/ad91cfd4-6f74-4a17-9678-92e2f95d0a7f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) which fans of [neither](https://substack.com/redirect/f00ea71b-ae46-4862-a83a-4f6f28a3238d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Biden nor Trump are likely to appreciate.
### **Clinton 's concessions**
Thirty years ago, Bill Clinton infamously embraced pro-business policies in order to compete with Republicans for donations from Wall Street. Widely credited with supposed political genius for his "[triangulation](https://substack.com/redirect/58b50bf3-b590-4f4d-9083-aa8bb5e9f2c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" strategy, Clinton ultimately traded principles for which Democrats had long fought in exchange for his personal political success.
By supporting Wall Street's agenda on [labor rights](https://substack.com/redirect/506721f3-b23b-4beb-b618-bdab6c80c57f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [international trade](https://substack.com/redirect/306fb272-ae66-426f-b513-c3506e9a0d0e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Clinton effectively broke the previous Republican monopoly on support from Wall Street. Few appreciated at the time how a Democratic president championing policies once favored only by Republicans would induce the entire political spectrum to [shift](https://substack.com/redirect/19023af8-92af-4ca2-970a-f56111d3038c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the right.
### **Obama 's obfuscations**
Seemingly inspired by Clinton's example (and advised by many of the very same apparatchiks), Barack Obama also broke with his party to embrace GOP policies on several fronts. His [bailout](https://substack.com/redirect/d2968627-1e75-40c1-9d17-97987ff72502?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) favoring Wall Street following the 2008 financial collapse and his tragic [centralization](https://substack.com/redirect/b5b288b9-fb86-4f5e-8c8b-7461cfd1d1e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of power in the executive branch offer two of the most disappointing examples.
Obama won the White House largely because he [promised](https://substack.com/redirect/e19829d4-828a-42ef-ad4f-86b1085828e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to repudiate the brutish and idiotic legacy of the Bush & Cheney administration's wars on Iraq, Afghanistan, and the U.S. Constitution. But--like Clinton--Obama found it easier once in the White House to side with the Washington establishment rather than stand by the communities that got him there.
Within Obama's first year as president, his senior legal advisor, who urged accountability for the CIA's torture program and the closure of the Guantanamo Bay detention facility, was [pushed](https://substack.com/redirect/4414a83f-0f4b-4510-8402-5d2bc583b05a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) out of office. Obama [replaced](https://substack.com/redirect/8d4e1815-6e3c-4698-8e26-6822985f02e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) him with a rabid militarist with [close ties](https://substack.com/redirect/a1f58082-908d-4918-889e-19013511be4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the Israeli regime that would go on to [escalate](https://substack.com/redirect/9c654f1c-d5ac-4606-a2cf-d7bdc4be1217?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) its longstanding genocide 15 years later.
The defining legacy of Obama's presidency was an eponymous healthcare reform that, as much as any other policy passed in the last generation, emerged as a lightning rod for partisan rancor. Obamacare expanded the ranks of Americans with health coverage while [denying](https://substack.com/redirect/c7a33154-e43c-4be8-b8f6-871332941172?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) public insurance options. As a result, it forced consumers to buy private insurance from corporations that have [predictably](https://substack.com/redirect/335542b7-c24a-4255-91a2-3a26c95b67f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) jacked up their rates since then.
In the wake of the 2008 financial crisis, Obama [focused](https://substack.com/redirect/85307cb9-9bc2-49c1-9488-414e527f8e84?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) his economic recovery efforts on Wall Street banks, choosing to [abandon](https://substack.com/redirect/3c57d2e6-ad01-43e4-9846-dbb3297f9087?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) homeowners and renters. When a grassroots movement occupied public spaces cities across the United States to call (among other things) for greater social equity, [federal officials](https://substack.com/redirect/ccab80c9-a812-4073-87ab-c2a24d1ff21b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) coordinated a crackdown to violently repress it.
Obama absurdly [bragged](https://substack.com/redirect/e17b091b-271b-4bc2-9127-3bc214371100?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about [expanding](https://substack.com/redirect/8ecf25ea-d118-4be3-8402-be19d3a9d2a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) fossil fuel extraction in the midst of a global climate crisis. He [undermined](https://substack.com/redirect/50e43c03-7b18-46cf-872d-d3a0b53950f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) civil liberties and consolidated the power of criminal intelligence agencies with [documented](https://substack.com/redirect/085331fd-d5bb-4544-b103-07074b206640?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) histories of human rights violations in dozens of countries all over the world.
In every one of these respects, Obama's administration effectively joined the GOP by declaring its allegiance to capitalism and militarism before democracy. Ari Fleischer, who served as press secretary under the George W. Bush administration, scathingly (and accurately) [described](https://substack.com/redirect/1d0826e9-234a-42a2-8eb8-aec650254114?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Obama administration as Bush's third and fourth terms.
Obama [prepared](https://substack.com/redirect/676f1133-86c9-4e61-a6d4-4e403746a2a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the White House for autocracy.
In retrospect, one of Obama's most destructive decisions may have been choosing Joe Biden as his Vice President. While Biden had a largely undistinguished record in the role, it was his status as Obama's VP that enabled Democratic Party insiders to [orchestrate](https://substack.com/redirect/534ce3e4-573f-4eed-bc1b-1b628f1a6225?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) his nomination in 2020 despite [greater](https://substack.com/redirect/febea7bc-e1f1-4ed3-b594-c14b04bec7a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) grassroots support for Bernie Sanders.
Many of us recognized at the time that, by choosing a figure whose [documented](https://substack.com/redirect/9e88e20d-f769-4f0a-b9f1-1d742faa1aba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) lies had [forced](https://substack.com/redirect/e449ad57-6336-449b-8f9f-2406a139702e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) him out of multiple previous presidential nomination contests (Biden), Democrats effectively announced their preference for Donald Trump over a popular Socialist backed by a massive youth movement who offered meaningful alternatives to the bipartisan dominance of Washington by Wall Street that Bill Clinton engineered.
We all got what they wanted.

### **Biden 's brutality**
Since riding Obama's coattails to the presidency, Joe Biden has embraced any number fascist policies, from [enabling](https://substack.com/redirect/9d7f783b-c2db-41dd-96c4-2e01d1f18806?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) genocidal violence abroad to [ignoring](https://substack.com/redirect/04b17cef-40fa-4285-83d2-e70d1aeedeba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Congress and [asserting](https://substack.com/redirect/3fdd1090-fc5c-4e02-9d8d-740e8fb583c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) an [unconstitutional](https://substack.com/redirect/4c4fa1fa-5932-4bfc-a841-25df6d9ebcb5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) unilateral authority to declare war. He has embraced openly fascist policies at our nation's borders, where international asylum-seekers entitled to residence within the U.S. are illegally [detained](https://substack.com/redirect/dd1650c0-8b7b-40ae-99d1-4d02c5fab465?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by the thousands. And, like his GOP predecessor, he has chosen to [duck debates](https://substack.com/redirect/fc84956b-848b-40b6-b6fb-5ca84c94cdba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) rather than respect even a pretense of democracy.

It will continue this analysis by expanding it to examine human rights, military industrial corruption, and how each of those spheres reveal the well-established fascism that too many liberals have ignored growing under their bipartisan feet..._

body:
I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zstt9qnkieohpa4l6kkjgl7a4b7miqahgrjn791g_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm6or5c1h2bs)
---

Friend,

Since the moment I got off the stage, I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future.

Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zkg7mhhk27nkk1rn56sk9l4p6dk50et8a1gv01p8_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm6or5c1h2bs "Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
---
| | | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z76272av50d5n9fisameof6gg5jqvrkorm99mj50_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm6or5c1h2bs)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _
---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**
---
| | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zgkkpdpm3ho5egqq7blbjj8pcqhu7i4qo4774vq8_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm6or5c1h2bs)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zoio4ect5lfe84hhh2i356hl1cmu4qk5t8rnnftg_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm6or5c1h2bs)
---

Now, I'm running for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

**[It would mean a lot to me if every single person _reading this today_ could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG! >>](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zfs0798o5sbhkehsa3lpei51guhjaogtdll7ldrg_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm6or5c1h2bs "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days.

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the strength of OUR movement?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zf4p0kvc96sesr97jne9ts4c8pnbobltf2fio47o_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm6or5c1h2bs "Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the strength of OUR movement?")**

---
| | [RUSH SUPPORT TODAY](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zlsdc0n22pnfh0ufhg11c16bvbcp5ttvaucdm6go_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm6or5c1h2bs)
---

Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, **[I need your help- starting right now.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z7klvt3kh6ma43e8t8gpae5kg583j6mituhve56g_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjgm6or5c1h2bs "I need your help – starting right now. ")**

Your contribution is what keeps this movement alive and thriving, so thank you for standing with me.

My very best,

---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

subject: We’ve just endorsed in the presidential primary ➡
body:
It’s time to secure and win now.
| | | |
---
|
---
| Patriot–

---
| First, I want to thank everyone who filled out our presidential primary endorsement survey. Thank you for your incredibly important input! Second, the results are in, and Tea Party Patriots Citizens Fund is officially endorsing Donald Trump today. Please see my full statement below, and you can also watch and share my _[endorsement video.](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb979466a55664/1edb979466a3af68 "endorsement video")_
> _Donald Trump was a magnificent president: our economy reached heights never before seen; our standard of living rose; crime was under control; our borders were better secured; America became an energy exporter and shed the shackles of dependence on foreign suppliers; foreign allies respected us even as our adversaries feared us; and our future looked bright. He was, in word and deed, the All-American President. Donald Trump was President to all, and he will be again. He didn’t target Americans who disagreed with him or spoke out against him. He didn’t have them arrested for exercising their First Amendment rights. In stark contrast to Joe Biden, Donald Trump honors the Constitution and loves America. He wants all Americans, no matter who they are, to more than succeed – he wants every American to thrive. He wants your family to flourish, even if you disagree with him. We know this is true because this is how he governed every day. Over the last several weeks, we have polled our grassroots supporters. They made their choice clear — Tea Party Patriots Citizens Fund activists want Donald Trump to be returned to the White House as the nation's 47th president. Our grassroots understand that the American experiment is at risk, and that the man most able to save it is Donald Trump. Consequently, I am honored and proud to declare that on behalf of our three million supporters, Tea Party Patriots Citizens Fund endorses Donald Trump for president._
Now is the time to come together to beat Joe Biden and the Democrats! **Going forward, we are going to need thousands of patriots to[ sign up to secure and win](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb979466a55664/1edb979466a3af6a "sign up to secure and win") the election.** Please keep an eye on communication from us and let’s get it done in 2024! In liberty, Jenny Beth Martin

Wade_ that the right to abortion was protected by the Constitution. **But nearly 50 years later, a very different, far-right Supreme Court overturned that decision, effectively criminalizing abortion in entire regions of the country.** We shouldn’t have to still be fighting this fight. We won in 1973, and that should have been the end of it. Today makes me think back to an event that we held at a senior center in Montgomery County. subject: Marie Perez: “Nobody stays awake at night worrying about the southern border.”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Joe Kent Victory Fund
body:
Dear Peter,
That subject line is not a joke or taken out of context. Sadly, it's real. Yes, my opponent Marie Perez literally said on a left-wing podcast:

"Nobody stays awake at night worrying about the southern border."
Can she really be this bad at her job? Can she really be this unserious about the crisis our nation is facing right now?
In 2023, US Border Patrol identified at least 169 migrants who were on the terrorist watch list -- a tenfold increase over the number in 2021. And that's only the ones they caught.
Why do terrorists feel emboldened to break into our country?
Simple: because my opponent voted against securing the border.
Will you help me defeat her so I can join other common-sense Republicans and our next Republican President to secure our border and stop terrorists from walking in like hotel guests?
Make an emergency contribution today at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/gR7ls7pOb6Uc8BHmHmHubg/jWjDg4hxKNvXxMzhQw73zQ)[.](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/gR7ls7pOb6Uc8BHmHmHubg/jWjDg4hxKNvXxMzhQw73zQ)
Marie Perez should know better: her own constituents here in Washington State are dying because of the fentanyl that also flows freely across the southern border.
In Clark County, the largest county in the district, there were 67 fentanyl overdose deaths in 2022. Four years earlier, there were just 11.
In that same year, authorities in Washington State seized at least 1.6 million fentanyl-laced pills, all from Mexico and made with Chinese ingredients.
Marie may not lose sleep over a crisis where terrorists and lethal drugs freely enter our country, putting families in Washington's 3rd District at risk, but I do.
And unlike Marie, it's not a problem I'm going to ignore and pretend doesn't exist: I'm going to solve it.
Help me defeat her by donating today at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/gR7ls7pOb6Uc8BHmHmHubg/jWjDg4hxKNvXxMzhQw73zQ)[.](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/gR7ls7pOb6Uc8BHmHmHubg/jWjDg4hxKNvXxMzhQw73zQ)
Respectfully,

Joe Kent
PS: My opponent Marie is dead wrong when she says "Nobody is losing sleep" over terrorists and fentanyl flooding across our border with Mexico. Help me replace her with somebody who is serious about solving this critical problem for our country. # On The Anniversary of Roe v. Wade

Peter:
Reflecting on the anniversary of Roe v. Wade has stirred a deep sense of responsibility within me. It's disheartening to witness the erosion of women's rights, especially here in Texas.
[**If you have time, please watch this 70-second video on how the decisions being made by men on our behalf have prompted me to take action. Your support is invaluable in the fight for women's rights.**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=91bfb46f84&e=a2a46ff12c)
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=94cb0a2cef&e=a2a46ff12c)
As a woman and a mother, I feel compelled to fight for a future where our freedoms are not unjustly taken away. I believe that by codifying Roe v Wade, we can secure and protect the rights that have been crucial for women throughout the US.
The nuanced nature of reproductive healthcare, with its impact on those seeking to expand their families, individuals receiving devastating news of an unviable pregnancy or fatal birth defect, and victims of sexual assault and incest, reveals that broad abortion laws go beyond just those making a "choice." Strict, black-and-white legislation has no room in this complex landscape.
That's why I've decided to run for US Congress in District 8, to be a voice for women and advocate for the autonomy we deserve over our bodies.
Join me in this important fight for women's rights. Together, we can create a future where every woman has the freedom and autonomy she deserves. This anniversary is not just a reflection on the past; **it's a call to action for a brighter** , more equitable future.

[**Peter - Let’s protect our rights. Sending me to Congress will mean one more vote to protect healthcare and a voice for the complex nature of this issue. Chip in today and help us make an impact.**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=35b69c1c37&e=a2a46ff12c)

King David’s momentous story provides profound insights into many of life’s most important questions

| | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2znuo07qm2q3hnn61dqsfrq5ond3nq0qjvjh85u7o_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjimcor4cth2bs)

| | Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don’t know his full story—especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons.

King David’s momentous story provides profound insights into many of life’s most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others?

Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **“The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King”** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David’s character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel.
---
| | **This is why we’ve produced our online course, “The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King,” which is now available on DVD. And you can reserve your copy using this secure link:**

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/david-story-dvd](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zcm8mulh8evgdmrhrm0tbbg6fcs3gqee2oo7hheo_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjimcor4cth2bs)** By viewing the course, you’ll learn more about the nature of God, family, leadership, sin, and repentance; in short, you’ll learn more about what truly matters in life. **I hope you’ll reserve your DVD today and share its abiding lessons with your family and friends. The DVD is perfect for a Bible study or homeschool curriculum.**

In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons. King David’s momentous story provides profound insights into many of life’s most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others? name: Nikki Haley
subject: My message to Americans
body:
Americans have a choice this election.

| |
---
| | | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c681117%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xHIos5pozAUeSb3gj2DOyw&sysid=1)
---

Friend,

At my CNN town hall I had an important message to share.

**Americans have a choice this election. **

You have a choice of whether you want more of the same, or if you want a new generation of conservative leadership.
_
Do you want another Trump-Biden rematch? A rematch of two candidates who are both about 80 years old and who put our country trillions of dollars deeper in debt?_

_Do you want Trump or Biden to be our options - both who lack a vision for our country’s future . . . because both are consumed by the past, by investigations, by vendettas and grievances?_

**America deserves better.**

We deserve a new direction under new conservative leadership.

We deserve a president who will focus on the needs of our people, not on themselves.

A president who will rebuild our economy, close our border, and stand up to our enemies.

Most importantly, we deserve a president who will stop our self-loathing, end the division and fear, and make America strong and proud!

But we still have a lot of work to do to get this message out to every voter ahead of the New Hampshire primary election tomorrow.

**[So, if you have even $10 or more to spare, can you rush a donation to fuel my campaign, and make these final days before New Hampshire votes our STRONGEST yet?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c681118%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=hlRVAX0840AHgiNHCkmtWg&sysid=1 "So, if you have even $10
or more to spare, can you rush a donation to fuel my campaign, and make these
final days before New Hampshire votes our STRONGEST yet?")**

---
| | [HELP FUEL MY CAMPAIGN](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c681119%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=E%2bZKGZOPuJCft0usPwbTJw&sysid=1)
---

Friend, people like YOU are the reason we’ve come this far, and YOU are the reason we can win this race and right this ship.

**But it’s crunch time, and we cannot afford to waste a single moment. **

We must:
* Host more town halls so I can share my vision with as many voters as possible.
* Amplify my message across the airwaves.
* Knock more doors and place more yard signs.
* Reach undecided and on-the-fence voters.
* WIN the fight to save our future.

**[Will you step up with just $10 or more to help fuel my campaign RIGHT NOW so we make every moment count?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c681110%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=9qj%2bDRsezU%2bBOTmIOIXggQ&sysid=1 "Will you step up with just
$10 or more to help fuel my campaign RIGHT NOW so we make every moment
count?")**

**At the end of the day,** this is not just about winning an election. This is about making America strong and proud again.

We can win this. But I need your help.

**[Can I count on you?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c681111%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=QdTCKWQdPmSR7tnnoCU9Cw&sysid=1 "Can I count on you?")**

Thank you in advance.

---
My very best,

Nikki Haley
