---
---
| | **More About Nikki Haley**

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c681114%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=DzowWhjdSfU0pmLAend1sA&sysid=1 "NikkiHaley_Podium")
---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States.

I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I’m running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor”** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. **And I’ll do it as your next President. **

As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c681125%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=3Q%2fCBpn%2fnWj50KfysaOVcQ&sysid=1 "Will you join me today and
help me save our country?")**

### _INTRODUCTION:_
## A FOX AMONG HEDGEHOGS

People are always trying to categorize and label things--even other people, right? It's quick and easy. Professionally, we're lawyers, doctors, teachers, farmers, accountants, mechanics, and so forth. Academically, **we 're either gifted, average, or challenged**. We have this degree or that degree. We're educated or dropouts. Politically, **we 're either Republicans or Democrats**. We're labeled by our skin color, our heritage, our religion, our age, our body shape, our sexual orientation, and on and on and on. If you don't fit neatly into this or that box, then you might be a misfit like me--and that's just fine.
Think about it: Can we humans really be reduced to a few small categories? Do _you_ fit neatly into a couple of boxes? How about the people you care about--do you typically describe them with a simple label or two? Of course not. Even those who are experts at one thing have wider experiences and broader knowledge to share. All of us are many things--and sometimes, none of the above. **By very definition, individuals are unique entities within an indivisible whole.** For humans, our personal blends of DNA, upbringing, mindset, and experience contribute to a shared heritage as _Homo sapiens_. And as peculiar vessels of knowledge, information, and wisdom, no two members of our species are alike. Isn't that amazing and wonderful?
* * *
[](https://substack.com/redirect/c2d0d05f-d37e-4a45-9fbd-646bc3345cf8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)| | |

| | [Vikram Mansharamani](https://substack.com/redirect/bab68980-d983-47f6-9181-c79be368a637?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)| | *
---|---|---
| Jan 7
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/c2d0d05f-d37e-4a45-9fbd-646bc3345cf8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
Somehow, though, **in today 's polarized world of siloed, either-or thinking, we seem to have forgotten that this amazing cacophony of diverse perspectives and ideas is a gift perfectly suited for our increasingly complex problems**--and it's not a gift we can afford to squander right now. So why do we continue to regard each other with the limited vocabulary of labels, boxes, and silos? I know I don't fit easily into a box, and you shouldn't have to, either. The world needs each of us and all of us to share and consider each other's full range of perspectives and ideas. **In an era defined by polarization, it 's time to start listening with open hearts and minds again instead of dismissing each other as this or that. We need to think for ourselves, respect each other, and move beyond labels and boxes.** Not doing so is destructive. With authentic curiosity, we must explore many viewpoints and regularly challenge our own beliefs. It's the only way to start thinking more holistically and critically _together_. **Less either-or thinking, more both-and collaboration.** The combination will help us successfully navigate the uncertainty and challenges of the twenty-first century.
This is why the only label I'm willing to accept is the one I've created for myself, mostly to appease those who still want to label me. I proudly call myself a generalist with a capital _G_. Russian-British philosopher Isaiah Berlin might have called me a fox among hedgehogs. Berlin wrote about the difference between these two animals in a 1953 essay, basing his ideas on a parable by the ancient Greek poet Archilochus: "The fox knows many things, but the hedgehog knows one big thing."
Those of you who have read my work before will have heard this analogy. But for those new to my story, here's an overview: Though different, foxes and hedgehogs have plenty in common. For one thing, they both exist in an uncertain world, just like we do. The fox responds to uncertainty by learning many things quickly to survive. It lives in a state of constant adaptation and creative problem-solving. The hedgehog approaches uncertainty with a single, important adaptation: self-defense. When it rolls into a tight ball and extrudes its coat of spines, it's difficult for predators to hurt it.
[Buy The Book](https://substack.com/redirect/ba731f57-0527-42c3-a09f-7303e1812a7c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
As Philip Tetlock has explained, foxes and hedgehogs help us understand two cognitive styles: "Foxes have different strategies for different problems. They are comfortable with nuance; they can live with contradictions. Hedgehogs, on the other hand, focus on the big picture. They reduce every problem to one organizing principle." Foxes are generalists, and hedgehogs are specialists. Both species have survived for millions of years, so their contrasting approaches both deserve consideration. But which is more equipped to navigate the world's current uncertainties?
To ensure I'm not falling into either-or thinking here, let me clarify: this is not an exercise in foxes _versus_ hedgehogs. I am a fox who learns from many hedgehogs. I just think the world needs more foxes because hedgehogs are abundant--and foxes are rare. Society is great at funneling people into areas of expertise but not so good at nurturing generalists. **Businesses and academia almost always favor deep expertise and specialization. It 's one reason why I've been swimming against the current most of my life.** But it has been worth it because I think we all benefit from the unique perspective of the generalists. Here's an example to get you thinking about this: We can certainly agree that expert nuclear physicists help us understand how protons and neutrons combine to form atomic energy, right? This is a necessary specialization. But when it comes to the threat of nuclear war, which is one outcome of atomic energy, the input of many different specialists is required--nuclear physicists, political leaders, economists, watchdog groups, policymakers, country experts, and so forth. Also necessary are the insights of generalists who can synthesize these expert viewpoints and make connections that the specialists might miss. We have plenty of the former and a dearth of the latter.
Despite this imbalance, somewhere along my delightful, sometimes challenging, and usually fulfilling journey, I discovered that being a fox, a generalist in all walks of life, was the perfect job for me--and the way I wanted to live.

* * *
It's far from the easiest road, but it has certainly been interesting and, I daresay, fulfilling. I have met with heads of state in Africa, academics in Lebanon, journalists in India, casino operators in Macau, doctors in Bangkok, cosmetics manufacturers in Russia, miners in Zimbabwe, financiers in Peru, and peace negotiators in Colombia. I've been on safari, gone diving with great whites, flown a helicopter, narrowly escaped an angry mob in Jakarta, played polo in Argentina, drunk too much during a state of emergency in Karachi, and become a regular rodeo attendee. I've had polygraph tests, dodged bullets, and narrowly escaped exposure to Ebola. I've run the Boston Marathon, written three books, and been listed as one of the one hundred most powerful people in global finance. I've traveled by private plane, railcar (with livestock!), and cargo boat, and even sped through the streets of Vietnam on a motorcycle. I have a PhD from MIT and a commercial truck driving certificate from Roadmaster Drivers School, and I've taught at Harvard and Yale. I've eaten Rocky Mountain oysters in Nebraska and _gou rou_ in Tianjin, China; been stuck in a sandstorm; had my phone electronically jammed by terrorists in Lebanon; and run for the US Senate in New Hampshire.
**What connects all these disparate events? A refusal to let society 's expectations guide my actions and a conscious decision to see the world as the extraordinary, interconnected whole it is rather than focusing merely on a fragment or two.** It's the interplay between different ideas, viewpoints, and areas of study that excites me. It's jumping from bucket to bucket to bucket nonstop that keeps my thinking muscles in shape and leads me to aha moments that experts often miss. I'm okay being a square peg in a world of round holes. I've found my happy place in our uncertain universe.
[Buy The Book](https://substack.com/redirect/ba731f57-0527-42c3-a09f-7303e1812a7c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
My amazing parents, who risked everything to begin a new life in a land that promised unlimited opportunity, taught me that courtesy and empathy should be more than actions; they must be a way of being. **Through my family and an eclectic mix of life experiences, I 've come to understand and respect that every perspective is biased, incomplete, and therefore limited.** And since that's the case, I know my own lens on the world is also biased, incomplete, and limited. So why not adopt multiple perspectives as part of my quest to understand our planet and its inhabitants better? Why not balance rugged individualism with the input of skilled experts? Why not think independently and unconventionally by keeping experts on tap, not on top? This approach has dramatically changed my thinking and the way I interact with the world. It has shifted my relationship with knowledge and the experiences and people who hold that knowledge. Being a generalist keeps me endlessly curious and forever humble--a healthy combination in unsteady times.
Perhaps the most wonderful thing about being a generalist is understanding that while there is absolutely a discernible, definable, perfectible way of _being_ a generalist, there is never (ever, ever) a prescribed way of _becoming_ a generalist. There are no college majors or degrees, no specific career paths or professional titles, and no self- help books to show you how.
_This is precisely why I have chosen to share my life story._
If, like me, you find yourself a square peg in a world of round holes, I hope my journey encourages you to stay strong, forge your own path forward, and remain true to yourself--despite the uphill battles you're sure to face. It may not be the easiest road, but it's very fulfilling and fabulously interesting. A generalist's journey is never boring. I've chosen to share some of the pivotal points along _my_ path to becoming a fully conscious generalist. Though your journey will be different--precisely because it will be _yours_ --I hope reading about the skills, habits, mindset, and practices I've learned along the way will smooth the road ahead for you. At the very least, I want you to know that you are not alone and that your efforts are worthwhile. **For me, pushing through the challenges has yielded rich rewards --opening many doors; presenting many career opportunities; improving my health; leading me to become a better husband, father, and member of my community; and instilling in me an ethos to give back and providing a means to do so**.
* * *
[](https://substack.com/redirect/c2d0d05f-d37e-4a45-9fbd-646bc3345cf8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)| | |

| | [Vikram Mansharamani](https://substack.com/redirect/bab68980-d983-47f6-9181-c79be368a637?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)| | *

| Jan 7
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/c2d0d05f-d37e-4a45-9fbd-646bc3345cf8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
In a complex and uncertain world full of hedgehogs, more foxes--more confident, conscious generalists--could help address today's intricate global threats and challenges. We foxes are still a scarce breed, even though, at the end of the day, I believe we are all capable of being both specialists and generalists. **And because we are lucky enough to live in a country that encourages freedom of thought, expression, and speech, we have a constitutional right to debate; dissent; and form strong opinions, ideas, and perspectives. This should never be taken for granted. With these inalienable rights comes the responsibility to listen to and respect the ideas of our fellow Americans --even when we disagree with them. Because the more either-or thinking we do, the more labels we apply and use to dismiss opposing viewpoints, the less vibrant our democracy becomes. America's great tapestry of ideas should be celebrated and cultivated.**
If you don't want to be put in a box, don't put others there. I've been fighting against this type of behavior my entire life. Instead, be a fox, an outside-the-box thinker. I've been on the generalist's journey since I was a child, even if I didn't know it all those years ago. It has been a long, winding, uphill road with fascinating scenery around every corner. I've had my fair share of challenges, laughs, tears, and moments of immense joy along the way. I hope you'll find my story interesting and useful. In the end, the most important thing I've learned is that the generalist's journey is never-ending--so, _festina lente_! Make haste slowly. Your journey awaits.

Introduction, The Making of a Generalist | | | Jan 22 | | | | | | | | | | | | One of the most common questions authors get asked is "Why did you write this book?" It's asked by the media, friends, family and colleagues. Given today is the official release date of , I thought I would share the book's introduction (in entirety below) which does a decent job of answering this question. Best, Vikram | | | | ---|---|--- | Jan 7 | | | ---|---|--- INTRODUCTION: A FOX AMONG HEDGEHOGS People are always trying to categorize and label things--even other people, right? It's quick and easy. Professionally, we're lawyers, doctors, teachers, farmers, accountants, mechanics, and so forth. Academically, we 're either gifted, average, or challenged. We have this degree or that degree. We're educated or dropouts. Politically, we 're either Republicans or Democrats. We're labeled by our skin color, our heritage, our religion, our age, our body shape, our sexual orientation, and on and on and on. If you don't fit neatly into this or that box, then you might be a misfit like me--and that's just fine. Think about it: Can we humans really be reduced to a few small categories? Do you fit neatly into a couple of boxes? How about the people you care about--do you typically describe them with a simple label or two? Of course not. Even those who are experts at one thing have wider experiences and broader knowledge to share. All of us are many things--and sometimes, none of the above. By very definition, individuals are unique entities within an indivisible whole. For humans, our personal blends of DNA, upbringing, mindset, and experience contribute to a shared heritage as Homo sapiens. And as peculiar vessels of knowledge, information, and wisdom, no two members of our species are alike. Isn't that amazing and wonderful? | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | Jan 7 | Somehow, though, in today 's polarized world of siloed, either-or thinking, we seem to have forgotten that this amazing cacophony of diverse perspectives and ideas is a gift perfectly suited for our increasingly complex problems--and it's not a gift we can afford to squander right now. So why do we continue to regard each other with the limited vocabulary of labels, boxes, and silos? I know I don't fit easily into a box, and you shouldn't have to, either. The world needs each of us and all of us to share and consider each other's full range of perspectives and ideas. In an era defined by polarization, it 's time to start listening with open hearts and minds again instead of dismissing each other as this or that. We need to think for ourselves, respect each other, and move beyond labels and boxes. Not doing so is destructive. With authentic curiosity, we must explore many viewpoints and regularly challenge our own beliefs. It's the only way to start thinking more holistically and critically together. Less either-or thinking, more both-and collaboration. The combination will help us successfully navigate the uncertainty and challenges of the twenty-first century. This is why the only label I'm willing to accept is the one I've created for myself, mostly to appease those who still want to label me. I proudly call myself a generalist with a capital G. Russian-British philosopher Isaiah Berlin might have called me a fox among hedgehogs. Berlin wrote about the difference between these two animals in a 1953 essay, basing his ideas on a parable by the ancient Greek poet Archilochus: "The fox knows many things, but the hedgehog knows one big thing." Those of you who have read my work before will have heard this analogy. But for those new to my story, here's an overview: Though different, foxes and hedgehogs have plenty in common. For one thing, they both exist in an uncertain world, just like we do. The fox responds to uncertainty by learning many things quickly to survive. It lives in a state of constant adaptation and creative problem-solving. The hedgehog approaches uncertainty with a single, important adaptation: self-defense. When it rolls into a tight ball and extrudes its coat of spines, it's difficult for predators to hurt it. As Philip Tetlock has explained, foxes and hedgehogs help us understand two cognitive styles: "Foxes have different strategies for different problems. They are comfortable with nuance; they can live with contradictions. Hedgehogs, on the other hand, focus on the big picture. They reduce every problem to one organizing principle." Foxes are generalists, and hedgehogs are specialists. Both species have survived for millions of years, so their contrasting approaches both deserve consideration. But which is more equipped to navigate the world's current uncertainties? To ensure I'm not falling into either-or thinking here, let me clarify: this is not an exercise in foxes versus hedgehogs. I am a fox who learns from many hedgehogs. I just think the world needs more foxes because hedgehogs are abundant--and foxes are rare. Society is great at funneling people into areas of expertise but not so good at nurturing generalists. Businesses and academia almost always favor deep expertise and specialization. It 's one reason why I've been swimming against the current most of my life. But it has been worth it because I think we all benefit from the unique perspective of the generalists. Here's an example to get you thinking about this: We can certainly agree that expert nuclear physicists help us understand how protons and neutrons combine to form atomic energy, right? This is a necessary specialization. But when it comes to the threat of nuclear war, which is one outcome of atomic energy, the input of many different specialists is required--nuclear physicists, political leaders, economists, watchdog groups, policymakers, country experts, and so forth. Also necessary are the insights of generalists who can synthesize these expert viewpoints and make connections that the specialists might miss. We have plenty of the former and a dearth of the latter. Despite this imbalance, somewhere along my delightful, sometimes challenging, and usually fulfilling journey, I discovered that being a fox, a generalist in all walks of life, was the perfect job for me--and the way I wanted to live. | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | Jan 7 | It's far from the easiest road, but it has certainly been interesting and, I daresay, fulfilling. I have met with heads of state in Africa, academics in Lebanon, journalists in India, casino operators in Macau, doctors in Bangkok, cosmetics manufacturers in Russia, miners in Zimbabwe, financiers in Peru, and peace negotiators in Colombia. I've been on safari, gone diving with great whites, flown a helicopter, narrowly escaped an angry mob in Jakarta, played polo in Argentina, drunk too much during a state of emergency in Karachi, and become a regular rodeo attendee. I've had polygraph tests, dodged bullets, and narrowly escaped exposure to Ebola. I've run the Boston Marathon, written three books, and been listed as one of the one hundred most powerful people in global finance. I've traveled by private plane, railcar (with livestock!), and cargo boat, and even sped through the streets of Vietnam on a motorcycle. I have a PhD from MIT and a commercial truck driving certificate from Roadmaster Drivers School, and I've taught at Harvard and Yale. I've eaten Rocky Mountain oysters in Nebraska and gou rou in Tianjin, China; been stuck in a sandstorm; had my phone electronically jammed by terrorists in Lebanon; and run for the US Senate in New Hampshire. What connects all these disparate events? A refusal to let society 's expectations guide my actions and a conscious decision to see the world as the extraordinary, interconnected whole it is rather than focusing merely on a fragment or two. It's the interplay between different ideas, viewpoints, and areas of study that excites me. It's jumping from bucket to bucket to bucket nonstop that keeps my thinking muscles in shape and leads me to aha moments that experts often miss. I'm okay being a square peg in a world of round holes. I've found my happy place in our uncertain universe. My amazing parents, who risked everything to begin a new life in a land that promised unlimited opportunity, taught me that courtesy and empathy should be more than actions; they must be a way of being. Through my family and an eclectic mix of life experiences, I 've come to understand and respect that every perspective is biased, incomplete, and therefore limited. And since that's the case, I know my own lens on the world is also biased, incomplete, and limited. So why not adopt multiple perspectives as part of my quest to understand our planet and its inhabitants better? Why not balance rugged individualism with the input of skilled experts? Why not think independently and unconventionally by keeping experts on tap, not on top? This approach has dramatically changed my thinking and the way I interact with the world. It has shifted my relationship with knowledge and the experiences and people who hold that knowledge. Being a generalist keeps me endlessly curious and forever humble--a healthy combination in unsteady times. Perhaps the most wonderful thing about being a generalist is understanding that while there is absolutely a discernible, definable, perfectible way of being a generalist, there is never (ever, ever) a prescribed way of becoming a generalist. There are no college majors or degrees, no specific career paths or professional titles, and no self- help books to show you how. This is precisely why I have chosen to share my life story. If, like me, you find yourself a square peg in a world of round holes, I hope my journey encourages you to stay strong, forge your own path forward, and remain true to yourself--despite the uphill battles you're sure to face. It may not be the easiest road, but it's very fulfilling and fabulously interesting. A generalist's journey is never boring. I've chosen to share some of the pivotal points along my path to becoming a fully conscious generalist. Though your journey will be different--precisely because it will be yours --I hope reading about the skills, habits, mindset, and practices I've learned along the way will smooth the road ahead for you. At the very least, I want you to know that you are not alone and that your efforts are worthwhile. For me, pushing through the challenges has yielded rich rewards --opening many doors; presenting many career opportunities; improving my health; leading me to become a better husband, father, and member of my community; and instilling in me an ethos to give back and providing a means to do so. | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | Jan 7 | In a complex and uncertain world full of hedgehogs, more foxes--more confident, conscious generalists--could help address today's intricate global threats and challenges. We foxes are still a scarce breed, even though, at the end of the day, I believe we are all capable of being both specialists and generalists. And because we are lucky enough to live in a country that encourages freedom of thought, expression, and speech, we have a constitutional right to debate; dissent; and form strong opinions, ideas, and perspectives. This should never be taken for granted. With these inalienable rights comes the responsibility to listen to and respect the ideas of our fellow Americans --even when we disagree with them. Because the more either-or thinking we do, the more labels we apply and use to dismiss opposing viewpoints, the less vibrant our democracy becomes. America's great tapestry of ideas should be celebrated and cultivated. If you don't want to be put in a box, don't put others there. I've been fighting against this type of behavior my entire life. Instead, be a fox, an outside-the-box thinker. I've been on the generalist's journey since I was a child, even if I didn't know it all those years ago. It has been a long, winding, uphill road with fascinating scenery around every corner. I've had my fair share of challenges, laughs, tears, and moments of immense joy along the way. I hope you'll find my story interesting and useful. In the end, the most important thing I've learned is that the generalist's journey is never-ending--so, festina lente! Make haste slowly. Your journey awaits. name: Nikki Haley
subject: This is now a two-person race.
body:
Let’s do this!

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqmrt2ilhpltn4t8v7em673b7nmfst01hkbcf6cg_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjimaob4c1h2bs)
---

Friend,

At one point in this campaign, there were 14 of us running.

But now, it's officially a _**TWO-PERSON**_ race between me and Donald Trump!

**[We can WIN this, but I need your help. Will you join me today?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zlaulq0ggdf2hiic7iq38kk817fakoclo8nh4djg_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjimaob4c1h2bs "We can WIN this, but I need your help. Will you join me today?")**

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4665e377p0ieg28bu5q7q522bejh4q339bunhu0_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjimaob4c1h2bs)
---
| | [DONATE](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znoig2bun03f8hvtn23igltspnu1k3tj7en3g8po_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjimaob4c1h2bs)
---

Now, there is a question that every American must answer. _Do you want more of the same, or do you want a new generation of conservative leadership?_

When I ask, "do you want more of the same," you know what I'm talking about. It's both Donald Trump and Joe Biden. It's about whether you want to stay stuck in the past or move into a better future.

Donald Trump and Joe Biden have so much in common.

_-> Seventy percent of Americans don't want another Trump-Biden rematch.
-> Most Americans disapprove of both.
-> Trump and Biden are both about 80 years old.
-> Trump and Biden both put our country trillions of dollars deeper in debt.
-> And Trump and Biden both lack a vision for our country's future . . . because both are consumed by the past, by investigations, and by vendettas and grievances._

**America deserves better!**

We deserve a new direction under new conservative leadership.

We deserve a president who will focus on the needs of our people, not on themselves.

We deserve a president who will rebuild our economy, close our border, and stand up to our enemies.

_**And most importantly, we deserve a president who will stop our self-loathing, end the division and fear, and make America strong and proud!**_

**Our campaign is the last best hope of stopping another Trump-Biden nightmare.** I am committed to the fight, but I cannot do it alone. I need every American who knows that we can be better as a country to join me.

**[Will YOU join me before it's too late?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z02e89koib873h0ckhqq75tnb7j4gidos1puldp0_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjimaob4c1h2bs "Will YOU join me before it’s too late?")**

Republicans have lost the popular vote in seven of the last eight presidential elections. That is nothing to be proud of. We should want to earn the support of a majority of Americans.

All the evidence shows that if it's a Trump-Biden rematch, it's going to be another tossup election. It could go either way. We could have more disputes over election interference. And Joe Biden could win again, with Kamala Harris waiting in the wings.

Every recent poll shows that when I go head-to-head against Biden, we win in a landslide. **It 's not even close. **

That means no recounts, no lawsuits, and no doubts. It means no more Chuck Schumer leading the Senate. No more endless votes for House Speaker because we'll have a huge House majority. We'll term limit the do-nothing Washington politicians. We'll rebuild our economy and secure our border. And make no mistake, we will restore our national pride. **We are blessed to live in America, and it 's time we remembered that.**

Now, with the primary tomorrow, I have one more thing to say: "Underestimate Me. That's Always Fun."

I have never lost a race and I don't intend to start now. I am in this to win, and I hope that I can count on having you by my side.

We don't have to go backwards. We are not destined to a repeat of Trump-Biden, but I need your help. **[Please chip in whatever you can today.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zs7o3raq0882ij3dv2i7kvib12qgacn4kqc7mig0_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjimaob4c1h2bs "Please chip in whatever you can today.")**

Together, we will make America strong and proud!

Let's do this!
---

My very best,
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zo03p8ugj814tb615pesi2cfvicpfdp7ul7uhkq8_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjimaob4c1h2bs)
---
Nikki Haley

| | | | |
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0o2514bahfaqbcore5od9ogscdc1uad3oai8cv8_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjimaob4c1h2bs "NikkiHaley_Merch")
---
| | [GET YOUR HAT NOW](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkejddekf9vspq95hpac60upnnhinevlkjeveqn8_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjimaob4c1h2bs "Claim Your Mug")
---

| | **More About Nikki Haley**

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1b7tdcitksqal7tcbqe8olpqcu19598m50mf1co_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjimaob4c1h2bs "NikkiHaley_Podium")
---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjpmk72id197civn4mllbdu9703rt5mtns1d7nhg_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjimaob4c1h2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: I know this is blunt. But it’s powerfully important that I make this clear: Republicans are coming for you.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
This would threaten abortion rights in all states — even in those that have passed protections.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1907%2E4032634%2EenZtGb)
---
This week officially marks the 51st anniversary of Roe v. Wade. But we can’t celebrate 51 years of abortion rights. Because right-wing extremists on the Supreme Court ripped away that freedom in June 2022. And the past 18 months have been one new layer of hell after another. A 10-year-old girl who ends up pregnant, can't get an abortion in her home state with her family, and instead has to travel out of state to get it straightened out. Women who have something go wrong in the middle of a pregnancy and their doctors trying to decide if their patient is close enough to death to warrant a life-saving abortion or if they’ll get sued for performing the procedure. And it's not one story. It's not 10. It's not 100. It's over and over and over. It's about people sitting in an examining room. A doctor and a patient in a tiny little room talking about their most intimate decisions and worries and fears and plans. And knowing that there's a third person in that room virtually: a Republican lawmaker. I was furious when the Roe decision came out. I was furious that women were being knocked aside by, frankly, a handful of men with very extremist views. Who decided on their own that, “Yeah, everybody gets the full range of medical choices...except this _one_ medical decision.” But people are fighting back. All across this country.
* Right after the Roe decision came down, this movement responded by supporting abortion funds in states with trigger laws, and **so far we have raised $267,000 to help abortion patients get the care they need.**
* Meanwhile, we supported pro-choice candidates across the country running against anti-abortion extremists in the 2022 midterms. **This team raised more than $230,000 to support those candidates, which made an incredible difference in the Senate races that came down to a wire.** Because of everyone who pitched in, we were able to keep our Senate majority.
* Abortion also got on the ballot in Kansas, in Ohio, in Michigan, and people who’d never been politically active before got together — old people, young people, people from rural areas, people from cities —and said our voices will be heard. And when they got the chance to do that, they enshrined abortion rights into law in their states, not by a little bit, not by a squeaker, but by a big margin. **This community helped raise an additional $188,000 to support the organizations working to secure abortion rights in those states and prevent these bans from affecting more patients.**

Yeah, people care about abortion. In fact, most people in our country want to see individuals and their doctors making decisions about abortion, not extremist politicians. And when we all get together and make our voices heard — when we all go to the ballot box — then by golly, we can get that done. While these gains are powerfully important and made a real difference, they could still be erased. If you live in one of those states that has protected access to abortion, celebrate, but understand, the Republicans are still coming for you. Right now, there's another decision pending at the Supreme Court, and that is to get rid of medication abortion. More than half of all abortions today are medication abortion — and the Republicans are trying to get that drug pulled off the market. Additionally, Trump and Republicans have made clear that if they take back control in Washington, a federal abortion ban is at the top of their to-do list. That would threaten abortion rights in all states — even in those that have passed protections.

So, if you're really fired up about this, what you want to do this year is follow the federal elections. When people say, “Who are you thinking about? Are you getting involved?” The answer is, I care about abortion. And that's why I'm volunteering for Joe Biden. That's why I'm volunteering in this Senate race. That's why I'm volunteering for this House race. That's why I'm sending ten bucks in to be able to help the cause. Remind everyone abortion is on the ballot, because it is. And if we get a majority in the House, a majority in the Senate, and Joe Biden still in the White House, we can make Roe versus Wade the law of the land. In fact, I think that's going to be the first substantive law that we pass. And along the way, we need to keep taking care of each other. We need to keep supporting abortion initiatives in states across the country — if it make a difference for just one patient between now and the election, that would be enough. [**So will you please pitch in $28 or anything you can to support Floridians Protecting Freedom? They just got abortion rights on the ballot in Florida, and now they’re working to turn out voters to make sure abortion protections are passed in the next election.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/1148?amount=28&t=8&akid=1907%2E4032634%2EenZtGb) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

body:
Good afternoon,
I received your information as a volunteer for Jared Lovelace 2024 campaign for US Congressional district 10. First, thank you for your interest in helping his campaign. I am coordinating with all the volunteers and need some information from you so that your help with Jared is most effective in helping him win. Please answer these few questions to help get us started together.

1.) What city and county do you live in? If not in Texas, where.
2.) In what capacity would you like to volunteer? (Phone calling, Block walking, Sending emails).
3.) How many hours are you able to volunteer and what days of the week?

If you are not able to volunteer for the campaign, would you consider a donation to the campaign through Jared2024.com to help us financially meet our operational needs?

Thanks again for your time and consideration in helping Jared.

\--

Campaign Manager

TO: House and Senate Democrats
FROM: Pro-Police Congresswoman Nicole Malliotakis (NY-11)

Dear House and Senate Democrats,

**In 2024, can you resolve to just let police officers do their jobs?**

Rising crime rates across the nation and declining enrollment in law enforcement careers is one of the worst situations we could be in. We must allow officers to enforce the law. For example - while other politicians want to defund & dismantle the #NYPD, I proudly continued delivering critical resources in 2023 to help them do their job, including millions for new police cars and plate readers to help stop vehicle thefts.

And I won’t stop in 2024; the brave men and women in uniform who protect all of us each and every day deserve all the support we can muster.

This year, I encourage all of you to Back the Blue and stand with those who risk their lives every single day to keep our families, our parents, our grandparents, our partners, our children, and our friends safe.

– Nicole Malliotakis

Peter, this is President Trump's former Cabinet Official Richard Grenell.

If there's one thing I learned while serving in Donald Trump's cabinet, it's that we need more America First patriots serving in Washington. It's crucial.

That's why I am proudly endorsing my friend Republican Max Ukropina for Congress in Orange County's 47th District ... and I'm writing to urge you to do the same.

It's the same fighting spirit he'll bring to the Democrats in November.

| | **Today marks 51 years since the original Roe v. Wade decision.** This day **_should_** be a day celebrating 51 years of progress for reproductive rights. But instead, we are faced with more and more attacks on women's right to choose across the country.

Today serves as a reminder to all of us what is at stake this year. It has never been more important for us to codify Roe into law and fight against anti-choice politicians threatening to strip reproductive rights across the country.

[This is why it’s so important we take back the House this year. body:
This is my abortion story.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77530364/450698197/-849459103?refcode=ea.247fe05b-48b9-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&ms=ea.247fe05b-48b9-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNDdmZTA1Yi00OGI5LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ODkb6Xov_RGbmEc-YrcQRKQ4jdkLz1DOAKZN8-AAU-E=&emci=ecc84e56-01b7-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&emdi=247fe05b-48b9-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&ceid=46764483)
---
Peter — When I was 21 years old, I had an abortion. **That abortion saved my life.** I was married when I found out I was pregnant. I wanted to start a family. One devastating diagnosis from my doctor later, and all my plans had to change. I had an aortic aneurysm that was at risk of rupturing. If it did, I would die. I also couldn't have it treated without first having an abortion. Peter, I was lucky. My choice to have an abortion was protected by _Roe v. Wade_. Since it was overturned and Tennessee’s disastrous abortion ban took effect, the decision my doctors and I made is one that a woman in Tennessee _can’t_ make today. The radical GOP won’t allow it. Women in Tennessee — and across this country in Republican-controlled states — are terrified of what might happen if they have an ectopic pregnancy, a fatal fetal abnormality, a miscarriage that doesn’t resolve without medical care, or any other of the devastating diagnoses that can happen in pregnancy. # Petition Season Starts Tomorrow!

Dear friend,
As you know, the 2024 Primary Season officially kicks off tomorrow, January 23rd, with the start of gathering signatures to get on the Republican ballot for the April 23rd Primary.
For Congress, Rob needs over 1,000 registered Republicans in the 8th Congressional District (Parts of Luzerne and Monroe, all of Lackawanna, Wayne and Pike Counties) to sign his petition. The petition period last three weeks with the deadline being February 13th.
Can we count on you to help Rob Bresnahan get on the Republican ballot?
**Rob is running for Congress to:**
* Fight inflation & rising costs
* Secure our border
* End the fentanyl crisis
* Make our communities safe
* Make sure our government stops wasting taxpayer dollars
* Invest in America

**Please reply to this email to let us know if you can circulate a petition for Rob or are will to signing a petition.**
We will email or mail you the petition along with petition instructions and talking points on Rob. If you are not able to circulate a petition but would like to sign it, we will make sure to get you a petition!
If you have any questions, please feel free to reach out to our Campaign Manager, [Derek Rockey](mailto:derek@robforpa.com?subject=Petition%20Question&body=) or our Political Director, [Frank Wojtash](mailto:frank@robforpa.com?subject=Petition%20Question&body=) via email. Their emails are linked on their names.
I’d like to thank all of you in advance for all your hard work and dedication to helping Rob bring New Leadership to NEPA!
Best Regards,
Team Rob Rob for PA │PO Box 971, Pittston, PA 18640

P.S. We have our first event of 2024 tomorrow night at Grotto Pizza in Wilkes-Barre from 6:00 PM-8:00 PM. Come by and grab a FREE slice of pizza and sign a petition for Rob! The details are below. Please respond to this email if you can make it.

subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=bcf92f9a732747dd9eae72f176151c92&_e=hsDVquHprdRbm3kCDVLpXdvsb23yg-2PItxfMWwL9aU8Jk4GQzaSr4Hn4B9tGWkeH4-MxS0UVxp3Q77TzAiifANzDoZpVTtbB0p2-A13lhDRQuQ0SEaHyhx3D4K73pPn3AiZ32gjQp6AQ-xxOisrAk-5zEwt9zoPJDc5TUmbzATmGtjm6wQZjmqZdAXlV79kHmqS75HLPt9PNL-vOkKfl7h4OpSFF90DR6-UaZYxcALO-LifeHdu1hmzdncksu8GK6a9JkqramGQlLp2Lj5lgDHAIMjnikbavQTz6ebA6UklUqXEGD_lncVKsqrDSVu6uhVOo6UQBbLsqWB8G78w5S4tqnBgxG6kcrhYrtE6pXAbz06zJJXWZ2_5QjL4e23fbsqvTPbWSE1INaRLt6q_cg%3D%3D) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=bcf92f9a732747dd9eae72f176151c92&_e=hsDVquHprdRbm3kCDVLpXdvsb23yg-2PItxfMWwL9aU8Jk4GQzaSr4Hn4B9tGWkeH4-MxS0UVxp3Q77TzAiifANzDoZpVTtbB0p2-A13lhDRQuQ0SEaHyhx3D4K73pPn3AiZ32gjQp6AQ-xxOisrAk-5zEwt9zoPJDc5TUmbzATmGtjm6wQZjmqZdAXlV79kHmqS75HLPt9PNL-vOkKfl7h4OpSFF90DR6-UaZYxcAKNKYo0Khin3z9I-B0FZlXrXKK8dBklQIRGjrKN44a_gdXU4-av_NTVZlv1oDt-TmJJnYnLYvgTYGeBgYCKLKLZ_brgtWsIg1sRxIreuWBfrXjDrajRzMOlF2ZWQ7OXBM4RJx26b78DjY5HuiUkCNTaGzCVx_aqkZJvl49Lw57U0A%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=bcf92f9a732747dd9eae72f176151c92&_e=hsDVquHprdRbm3kCDVLpXdvsb23yg-2PItxfMWwL9aU8Jk4GQzaSr4Hn4B9tGWkeH4-MxS0UVxp3Q77TzAiifANzDoZpVTtbB0p2-A13lhDRQuQ0SEaHyhx3D4K73pPn3AiZ32gjQp6AQ-xxOisrAk-5zEwt9zoPJDc5TUmbzATmGtjm6wQZjmqZdAXlV79kHmqS75HLPt9PNL-vOkKfl7h4OpSFF90DR6-UaZYxcAJIwONV7MuJqjNIYeZwgts-DtnhMUwwj95phd5nOuHFJbpY0ozbW6OkOnqhsNTCFA0aOqrjlW6YagpZ4Qap8O5gnoH2ONM5krqVBMgd9P3EFdSX4wS3eWGiPiNP4huvpC05OsT0xoFvr2iRhNMQeSKtIsyyFAfNs8IvJAMtfrZKAg%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

name: Team Cori
subject: Escaping the winter cold
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Cori Bush for Congress
body:
Nobody should go through the extreme cold without a roof over their head. | |
---
Peter, **** **** **** **** **** **** Over the last few weeks, tens of millions of people in the middle of the country had to endure the coldest depths of winter; parts of the Midwest as cold as -30 degrees Fahrenheit. **Nobody should go through the extreme cold without a roof over their head. That’s what Cori’s been advocating for since she first stepped foot in Congress.** As a single mother, Cori experienced the trauma, stress, stigma and pain that comes with being unhoused while sleeping in her car with her two kids. Fixing this crisis is a top priority of hers. A safe place to live is a human right that has been undermined by intentional policy decisions. That is why, as co-chair of the Congressional Caucus on Homelessness, **Cori reintroduced the Unhoused Bill of Rights, legislation that commits the federal government to addressing the root of our nation’s housing crisis.** Together, we can end the unhoused crisis by 2027. This brutally cold winter has made it abundantly clear that we need the Unhoused Bill of Rights urgently. Because not a single person should have to worry about how they’re going to shelter from temperatures that can give one frostbite within minutes. Cori is committed to ensuring that the Unhoused Bill of Rights is adopted towards helping to keep people permanently housed.**In the richest country in the world, we all deserve to have a place to live.** Anything other than that is unacceptable. clean_body: Nobody should go through the extreme cold without a roof over their head. | | Peter, ** Over the last few weeks, tens of millions of people in the middle of the country had to endure the coldest depths of winter; parts of the Midwest as cold as -30 degrees Fahrenheit. Nobody should go through the extreme cold without a roof over their head. That’s what Cori’s been advocating for since she first stepped foot in Congress. As a single mother, Cori experienced the trauma, stress, stigma and pain that comes with being unhoused while sleeping in her car with her two kids. Fixing this crisis is a top priority of hers. A safe place to live is a human right that has been undermined by intentional policy decisions. That is why, as co-chair of the Congressional Caucus on Homelessness, Cori reintroduced the Unhoused Bill of Rights, legislation that commits the federal government to addressing the root of our nation’s housing crisis. Together, we can end the unhoused crisis by 2027. This brutally cold winter has made it abundantly clear that we need the Unhoused Bill of Rights urgently. Because not a single person should have to worry about how they’re going to shelter from temperatures that can give one frostbite within minutes. Cori is committed to ensuring that the Unhoused Bill of Rights is adopted towards helping to keep people permanently housed.In the richest country in the world, we all deserve to have a place to live. What I wore to work every day? No choice. Where I would live? No choice. Who my boss was? No choice. **But one choice I always had? My reproductive healthcare.**
That's a choice Brian Fitzpatrick voted to take away from women in the military last summer.
See, after the Supreme Court struck down Roe v. Wade – which should have turned 51 today – the Pentagon set a policy to pay for travel to access reproductive healthcare if a service member lives in a state that bans abortion. Fitzpatrick joined with the majority of Republicans last summer to try and overturn that policy. (Luckily, they failed.)
Service members choose to risk our lives for this country. What we don't choose is whether we live in a state that bans abortion or protects it.
And what angers me even more? It's only going to get worse.
Because not only are Fitzpatrick and his fellow Republicans continuing to go after service members' abortion freedom – Speaker Mike Johnson has made it clear he wants a national abortion ban.

51 years ago today, the Supreme Court decided _Roe v. Wade_ , which enshrined constitutional protections for abortion access.

As we look back on this day, there’s no mistaking that our reproductive freedom is under attack nationwide. Nearly two years ago, the Court rolled back the fundamental rights afforded to women by _Roe v. Wade_ , and people across the country are paying the price.

**Peter, the fight for reproductive justice is deeply personal to me.** As a pediatrician, I know firsthand that the government should have no place in private decisions made between a doctor and patient.

**[Yet, this year, as Donald Trump and his MAGA Republicans run on a nationwide abortion ban, I need your help to combat this extremism.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77535359/450708649/537837852?amount=10&refcode=em_fr_2024.01.22_b1_yc_60do-30dc&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNzhlZmJkMS00ZGI5LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EcZ98d07dwPO4XM9znzfCQrS5S6653SUkK_2V_2xcNk=)** I promise I will never stop fighting for bodily autonomy in Congress, and we should demand better than this anti-abortion, anti-science position from the Republican Party.

If you’re looking to make a positive difference and amplify a national voice for reproductive justice, you can start a monthly donation to my re-election campaign today. In that decision, the Court confirmed that every one of us should have the freedom to decide if and when we want to have a family. It wasn’t perfect — anti-abortion extremists immediately started finding loopholes and legislating who could access abortion, where they could find care, and how long they had to do so — but it laid the groundwork for a future where access would be the rule, and not the exception. **Today, on what should be Roe v. | Peter,

Today would have marked the**51st Anniversary of _Roe v. Wade_** , the landmark decision that secured the right to an abortion. When I was marching for reproductive rights during my college years or when I was deciding when to start my own family, _I never expected that the young women of today would have fewer rights to bodily autonomy than my generation._

The Supreme Court's radical decision to overturn _**Roe v. Wade**_ threatens the autonomy, safety, and dignity of generations of women. As the mother of three sons, I know that nothing is more fundamental than the right to choose when to start or grow a family.

Now more than ever, we must stand up for our privacy and bodily autonomy. The stakes couldn’t be higher in this election, and the choice couldn’t be clearer. **With MAGA Republicans determined to pass a nationwide abortion ban, our only choice is to take back the House and elect leaders committed to restoring the right to an abortion nationwide.**

When I was marching for reproductive rights during my college years or when I was deciding when to start my own family, I never expected that the young women of today would have fewer rights to bodily autonomy than my generation. The Supreme Court's radical decision to overturn Roe v. Wade threatens the autonomy, safety, and dignity of generations of women. As the mother of three sons, I know that nothing is more fundamental than the right to choose when to start or grow a family. Now more than ever, we must stand up for our privacy and bodily autonomy. The stakes couldn’t be higher in this election, and the choice couldn’t be clearer. With MAGA Republicans determined to pass a nationwide abortion ban, our only choice is to take back the House and elect leaders committed to restoring the right to an abortion nationwide. Make no mistake, this race is crucial for protecting our freedoms. My opponent has said that he wants to ban all abortions - even in cases of rape or incest. As the Representative for Washington's 6th Congressional District, I will work tirelessly to restore our reproductive rights and resist attempts to roll back progress. body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2bd25c2167004055afa8256fba6ae5c3&_e=-XBDpJ9z6jgHrFvhkX4ZVo6tw47sdAwwl4TQCojP38MBhOqvB4hd8t49M6pHph-VSDeCUUp760-kgzcnIAoJX58mN1hMSJzwL9AERhso0dsYj6yOlVutw58TkkQb4vce-aQjMGxbSopD4ohdVar8XcxTOiu_9kT3O3N4dPciRh6tu63MpnBmLGNGvpoSm_q0QesEWY1jXkvLzB1dhK2l1uLOGhYCgmlFuzkjDacbX_onHXMY1rG-Kuq77L1drpYZQqHe-UFlMF19798GGAx4PGDbxbqXKUMwhd19hfLfCwDL05KNuq_daeNdnSgOlmDNKs0NFuVYVywi6b-dFqSpPZTr0zYUOGH1O1R0sKqdKoS1WDyH7HpXLpUA7bz32mkMJnc9olVE4f3to7lTQoqA8Q%3D%3D) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2bd25c2167004055afa8256fba6ae5c3&_e=-XBDpJ9z6jgHrFvhkX4ZVo6tw47sdAwwl4TQCojP38MBhOqvB4hd8t49M6pHph-VSDeCUUp760-kgzcnIAoJX58mN1hMSJzwL9AERhso0dsYj6yOlVutw58TkkQb4vce-aQjMGxbSopD4ohdVar8XcxTOiu_9kT3O3N4dPciRh6tu63MpnBmLGNGvpoSm_q0QesEWY1jXkvLzB1dhK2l1uLOGhYCgmlFuzkjDacbX_obn6B93vKTI0L5idD6FUmTlATDzW0D4X1exnurnXeumGC_LLXfCLg55CmI93X5Z0VXVxFWIYwN6MwObNNxmcYU0CZFqcyaZf3Td_L7t9ZW4F4tjsWVxDfNgGxFOD3d_WsxM30Yaw0vh9N_NVsItVeGYRQp_GRWhJI6ozQ7l8E31Q%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2bd25c2167004055afa8256fba6ae5c3&_e=-XBDpJ9z6jgHrFvhkX4ZVo6tw47sdAwwl4TQCojP38MBhOqvB4hd8t49M6pHph-VSDeCUUp760-kgzcnIAoJX58mN1hMSJzwL9AERhso0dsYj6yOlVutw58TkkQb4vce-aQjMGxbSopD4ohdVar8XcxTOiu_9kT3O3N4dPciRh6tu63MpnBmLGNGvpoSm_q0QesEWY1jXkvLzB1dhK2l1uLOGhYCgmlFuzkjDacbX_rEl1z-eralCeAYZbzuXtrwaDaGH52ymxuU-rPWYSpyw82Jud2XyZKTJ96tw4z0_xo2Of5aKavNp0a1PWkjPzc0neUNY9QpfxH2i8uGEx8yVyvYeTg6wUbvRzxQCr3KqK6ngwnFUIaLdUad3P0FNTF-bv4c-hIWqo0VCyNxeNpRFg%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: This week in Texas - Jan. 22
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY POWERED BY PEOPLE
body:
[1]Powered By People

Here are the issues that Powered by People is working on this week:

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Fighting corruption

Last week served as proof that Texas is run by the most corrupt government
in state history:

* We learned that Governor Abbott accepted [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/61930?source=ema20240122-238274&t=1001&akid=238274%2E444211%2ENOskMe ]a $6 million donation from
an out-of-state billionaire in return for pushing a private school
voucher scam in our state.

* The [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/61931?source=ema20240122-238274&t=1002&akid=238274%2E444211%2ENOskMe ]DOJ report on Uvalde reminded us that Abbott and Texas DPS
Director Steve McCraw engaged in a massive cover-up scheme after the
shooting, and that not a single person has been fully held accountable
for the failed response.

* In a civil court filing, Attorney General Paxton [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/61932?source=ema20240122-238274&t=1003&akid=238274%2E444211%2ENOskMe ]admitted to key
allegations that led to his impeachment — just four months after
Republicans in the Senate acquitted Paxton on all 16 charges of
corruption and abuse of public office.

* We were reminded that Lieutenant Governor Dan Patrick took a [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/61933?source=ema20240122-238274&t=1004&akid=238274%2E444211%2ENOskMe ]$3
million donation from a pro-Paxton PAC just weeks before leading the
rigged Senate trial that led to Paxton’s acquittal.

Powered by People is doing all we can to bring attention to this, to
ensure voters understand the consequence of keeping these people in
office, and to mobilize Texans around the opportunity to replace them.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Organizing for pro-choice leaders

Today marks the 51st anniversary of the Roe v. Wade decision. It serves as
a reminder that since that landmark decision was struck down in 2022,
Texas women now enjoy fewer rights in this country than they did half a
century ago.

As we approach a critically important election, Powered by People is
leading an aggressive campaign to ensure that every Texas voter knows
that:

* Texas Republicans enacted a [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/61934?source=ema20240122-238274&t=1005&akid=238274%2E444211%2ENOskMe ]near-total abortion ban, with no
exception for rape or incest;

* The Texas Supreme Court has [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/61935?source=ema20240122-238274&t=1006&akid=238274%2E444211%2ENOskMe ]refused to uphold the law’s narrow
medical exceptions, forcing women to carry dangerous, nonviable
pregnancies that could kill them;

* And that Republicans in at least six Texas cities and counties have
passed ordinances that [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/61936?source=ema20240122-238274&t=1007&akid=238274%2E444211%2ENOskMe ]ban women from traveling on local roads to
seek an abortion out of state.

I am confident that the voters that we reach and register between now and
November will help us elect pro-choice leaders and win a better future for
our state.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Registering voters and winning elections

With so much at stake right now, Powered by People is training thousands
of volunteers to register and organize the voters we need to win elections
in Texas.

If you live in Texas, sign up for a Volunteer Deputy Registrar (VDR)
training to register voters in your community:

Sign up for a virtual VDR training: [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/60944?_gl=1%2A1kqvxs1%2A_gcl_au%2AMTQxNjY4NzIwNi4xNzAyODQ3MzAx%3Fsource%3Dema20240122-238274&t=1008&akid=238274%2E444211%2ENOskMe ]Tuesday, Jan. 23 at 6:00 PM
[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/60945?_gl=1%2A1kqvxs1%2A_gcl_au%2AMTQxNjY4NzIwNi4xNzAyODQ3MzAx%3Fsource%3Dema20240122-238274&t=1009&akid=238274%2E444211%2ENOskMe ]Thursday, Jan. 25 at 12:00 PM

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240122.KT-Q6T&refcode=ema20240122-238274&t=1010&akid=238274%2E444211%2ENOskMe ]Otherwise, please consider chipping in $3 or whatever
you can today to help us recruit volunteers and register more voters.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240122.KT-Q6T&refcode=ema20240122-238274&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1029&akid=238274%2E444211%2ENOskMe ]DONATE $3

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

I hope it’s a great week for you.

Beto

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to act. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.betoorourke.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1030&akid=238274%2E444211%2ENOskMe

body:

Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.

Overturning Roe v. Wade and leaving abortion rights up to the states wasn’t enough for MAGA, big-government Republicans

Janelle Stelson has spent her career advocating for truth and integrity, and now she's running to unseat extremist Scott Perry and represent Pennsylvania's 10th District in Congress. If you’d like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://secure.ngpvan.com/p/57CdP-wFgkuQm58EpOgxvQ2?unsubscribedata=IirMzt3DkbwEKQ4TvZxZ1cM6oOsaCbevshC4sB%2FuWv3TmXfGjUfLFimQhHRAmGWMF%2B%2BMAjYmR5YX1n%2BCtSW5TGCv4nCk8NHcGOklp0gWyUADFu9OaoMccu1BC6ciHQhWz566eqbhpCJ%2FuBN07r2VPVCOmhrE2aqAEUuGP8G8w0XkV35P%2BeyFlJyX3Yo1Un8cxG1qN2QS6MZJTgzdGHDJa39ocBd1JPRezAFBo6auTMHXFi7XjzyyX0iHJWfeRWAerL6%2B6H8VZ2%2BKqBmPE28H12gzScKrjb%2F7kysfLh5GROQNigtAlMmjdCQa0TjvqIIcLCVoeiQfsyrYqVwJbrhUTExPwZXywxEgBSzyHuEt0azz77B77xUR3MOfIe4l3TSHksgDFlYTmwDfbm%2BvgVKH969zxBdwUud2uTRvxg43FCiW4hs5OiU8tCo%2FU24TUZWm)

Fifty-one years ago today, the United States Supreme Court ruled that the right to privacy, inherent in the Fourteenth Amendment, protects a woman’s right to have an abortion. That landmark decision was _Roe v. Wade._ Our sisters, mothers, aunts, grandmothers, and mentors fought long and hard for that victory in 1973, and like so many of you, I am still reeling from the devastating Dobbs decision. **I was on live television when the news came down about _Roe v. Wade_ being overturned. I had to look into the camera in my most nonpartisan way and tell every woman watching that her rights had been rolled back 50 years. It took a big chunk out of my heart.** But overturning _Roe v. Wade_ and leaving abortion rights up to the states wasn’t enough for MAGA, big-government Republicans. That’s why on Thursday, House Republicans **(Congressman Scott Perry included)** voted to pass two egregiously anti-choice bills. Scott Perry and his MAGA buddies in Congress won’t stop here— **they won’t stop until they’ve totally banned abortion in all 50 states.** Although I’ve been reporting on news and politics for nearly 40 years, I decided to run for Congress because I had to **_do something._** I could not sit on the sidelines and watch far-right extremists like Scott Perry continue to roll back our reproductive freedoms. If we want to stop Republicans from further jeopardizing every American’s basic rights, **we need to flip the House blue. And the path to flipping the House runs through PA-10. subject: This is now a two-person race.
body:
Let’s do this!

| |

Friend,

At one point in this campaign, there were 14 of us running.

But now, it's officially a _**TWO-PERSON**_ race between me and Donald Trump!

**[We can WIN this, but I need your help. Will you join me today?](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zp57ni8t152327ltssms76dsu26utiiekk0r04u0_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjhmapj0cth2bs "We can WIN this, but I need your help. Will you join me today?")**

| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zetnj9d6nq3j59f53utir20e56i764ub54iclca8_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjhmapj0cth2bs)

---

Now, there is a question that every American must answer. _Do you want more of the same, or do you want a new generation of conservative leadership?_

When I ask, "do you want more of the same," you know what I'm talking about. It's both Donald Trump and Joe Biden. It's about whether you want to stay stuck in the past or move into a better future.

Donald Trump and Joe Biden have so much in common.

_-> Seventy percent of Americans don't want another Trump-Biden rematch.
-> Most Americans disapprove of both.
-> Trump and Biden are both about 80 years old.
-> Trump and Biden both put our country trillions of dollars deeper in debt.
-> And Trump and Biden both lack a vision for our country's future . . . because both are consumed by the past, by investigations, and by vendettas and grievances._

**America deserves better!**

We deserve a new direction under new conservative leadership.

We deserve a president who will focus on the needs of our people, not on themselves.

We deserve a president who will rebuild our economy, close our border, and stand up to our enemies.

_**And most importantly, we deserve a president who will stop our self-loathing, end the division and fear, and make America strong and proud!**_

**Our campaign is the last best hope of stopping another Trump-Biden nightmare.** I am committed to the fight, but I cannot do it alone. I need every American who knows that we can be better as a country to join me.

**[Will YOU join me before it's too late?](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zsp9ojt5e0olo2itg137ujm3v534eopljb5s5hjg_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjhmapj0cth2bs "Will YOU join me before it’s too late?")**

Republicans have lost the popular vote in seven of the last eight presidential elections. That is nothing to be proud of. We should want to earn the support of a majority of Americans.

All the evidence shows that if it's a Trump-Biden rematch, it's going to be another tossup election. It could go either way. We could have more disputes over election interference. And Joe Biden could win again, with Kamala Harris waiting in the wings.

Every recent poll shows that when I go head-to-head against Biden, we win in a landslide. **It 's not even close. **

That means no recounts, no lawsuits, and no doubts. It means no more Chuck Schumer leading the Senate. No more endless votes for House Speaker because we'll have a huge House majority. We'll term limit the do-nothing Washington politicians. We'll rebuild our economy and secure our border. And make no mistake, we will restore our national pride. **We are blessed to live in America, and it 's time we remembered that.**

Now, with the primary tomorrow, I have one more thing to say: "Underestimate Me. That's Always Fun."

I have never lost a race and I don't intend to start now. I am in this to win, and I hope that I can count on having you by my side.

We don't have to go backwards. We are not destined to a repeat of Trump-Biden, but I need your help. **[Please chip in whatever you can today.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zrhtdmognuig01em0b2u911ksdb4hbbgutmlhlng_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjhmapj0cth2bs "Please chip in whatever you can today.")**

Together, we will make America strong and proud!

Let's do this!
---

My very best,
