My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zhpv8iqf6c050ptjafstv675u65ogp3ht3q7dob8_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cjhmapj0cth2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

Donald Trump and Joe Biden have so much in common. -> Seventy percent of Americans don't want another Trump-Biden rematch. -> Most Americans disapprove of both. -> Trump and Biden are both about 80 years old. -> Trump and Biden both put our country trillions of dollars deeper in debt. -> And Trump and Biden both lack a vision for our country's future . . . because both are consumed by the past, by investigations, and by vendettas and grievances. America deserves better! We deserve a new direction under new conservative leadership. We deserve a president who will focus on the needs of our people, not on themselves. We deserve a president who will rebuild our economy, close our border, and stand up to our enemies. And most importantly, we deserve a president who will stop our self-loathing, end the division and fear, and make America strong and proud! Our campaign is the last best hope of stopping another Trump-Biden nightmare. I am committed to the fight, but I cannot do it alone. I need every American who knows that we can be better as a country to join me. "Will YOU join me before it’s too late?" Republicans have lost the popular vote in seven of the last eight presidential elections. That is nothing to be proud of. We should want to earn the support of a majority of Americans. All the evidence shows that if it's a Trump-Biden rematch, it's going to be another tossup election. It could go either way. We could have more disputes over election interference. And Joe Biden could win again, with Kamala Harris waiting in the wings. Every recent poll shows that when I go head-to-head against Biden, we win in a landslide. It 's not even close. That means no recounts, no lawsuits, and no doubts. It means no more Chuck Schumer leading the Senate. No more endless votes for House Speaker because we'll have a huge House majority. We'll term limit the do-nothing Washington politicians. We'll rebuild our economy and secure our border. And make no mistake, we will restore our national pride. We are blessed to live in America, and it 's time we remembered that. Now, with the primary tomorrow, I have one more thing to say: "Underestimate Me. That's Always Fun." I have never lost a race and I don't intend to start now. I am in this to win, and I hope that I can count on having you by my side. We don't have to go backwards. We are not destined to a repeat of Trump-Biden, but I need your help. "Please chip in whatever you can today." Together, we will make America strong and proud! Let's do this! My very best, | Nikki Haley | | | | | | | | "NikkiHaleyMerch" | | "Claim Your Mug" | | More About Nikki Haley | "NikkiHaleyPodium" My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States. I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor" because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. name: Reclaiming American Freedom
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=8de88822cc984d4aa529508375104218&_e=iwE7ryHvuJMs8Qlj4wiHMbgyns98r-S7Vojr01Hzlv4HFgr5XEuB_ribFatHh2agff_F_G4l93LWZfhwwrX0LFDiErdetHoFgY44ePMuuHY5p30kVw64JDwgkZqqX8uMbLiUwbnn3uhSMpq3ZIaeI7lqWOEQXmb3fdbTEzHDVg0ZdZO4_AtuesHTKo4S8w4yTDixgRZ03h4F0ZV9BsYIhxUpQ57ofnRaomjht-sqIXtLefv549f-IAp_8uUBCBdVNVu6RrY56yoAOkiJsfGOPrHmtQ4tQo1UVSZ40VHGGkq0KybAnv6dbJy1bQFnmhcsYmYIzhQh0FlA643qctfkGkeuCfbtpsY7mKDF1iYx1HpL8od81nHEUujNHyiiR96YEBv-LqPfnlOZ1kFbXB4jZg%3D%3D) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=8de88822cc984d4aa529508375104218&_e=iwE7ryHvuJMs8Qlj4wiHMbgyns98r-S7Vojr01Hzlv4HFgr5XEuB_ribFatHh2agff_F_G4l93LWZfhwwrX0LFDiErdetHoFgY44ePMuuHY5p30kVw64JDwgkZqqX8uMbLiUwbnn3uhSMpq3ZIaeI7lqWOEQXmb3fdbTEzHDVg0ZdZO4_AtuesHTKo4S8w4yTDixgRZ03h4F0ZV9BsYIhxUpQ57ofnRaomjht-sqIXumTtLQlQ7wy5hRy3x58vuYk00T9uPtBxtmG1jF1RbwH_oX9GLGve2svLZ66bihEfS7aQ--_KJ4xJ4WxbxnYeJpt4PSDj1Wy-0in26pWsudKkCq0dD356SLFHobBUXHPy_GGIH7bJfMVKqPMjayE4LcVYzlK4YpjGW46VU4MnGIsQ%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=8de88822cc984d4aa529508375104218&_e=iwE7ryHvuJMs8Qlj4wiHMbgyns98r-S7Vojr01Hzlv4HFgr5XEuB_ribFatHh2agff_F_G4l93LWZfhwwrX0LFDiErdetHoFgY44ePMuuHY5p30kVw64JDwgkZqqX8uMbLiUwbnn3uhSMpq3ZIaeI7lqWOEQXmb3fdbTEzHDVg0ZdZO4_AtuesHTKo4S8w4yTDixgRZ03h4F0ZV9BsYIhxUpQ57ofnRaomjht-sqIXvuGVmSFFHTSLZBI8Lv9eW0mAzyxHTohxMl5BslUf0Bcv5nkwlfKVZsZXVoyWLVQ5NborgbXz4SvtfAntT5RACJPsKGINgu3QRC-XMAG_ZZaOxvBYLgtPLvYHdnCVfzXTz-UvmrTLWL4Q4ZnmjL-y_2l1MW7M6snv8xQYixJrsTJw%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

These efforts include: Teaching bright and principled students --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, classical liberal arts education, including a required course on the Constitution Distributing Imprimis , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon Producing and promoting free online courses for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics Providing a classical K-12 curriculum with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. clean_body: I am proudly pro-choice and believe that the right of every person to choose what to do with their own body is an essential human right. | | | | I am proudly pro-choice and believe that the right of every person to choose what to do with their own body is an essential human right. The Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade immediately stripped millions of Americans of their fundamental right to choose – and left millions more scared and outraged. In the wake of the Dobbs ruling, I voted to pass two bills – the Women's Health Protection Act and the Ensuring Women's Right to Reproductive Freedom Act – to protect women's healthcare rights. Nevertheless, Congressional Republicans have made clear that if they retake a majority in Washington, they will move quickly to outlaw abortion nationwide. A nationwide ban on abortion would override the protections here in New Jersey and would endanger the lives of countless women across this country. In the Senate, I will not rest until we pass a clear, comprehensive law restoring reproductive freedom for everyone, everywhere in this country. Here's the truth, we need an unapologetically pro-choice majority in Congress. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77540598/450723086/1993432125?refcode=BLU_EM_ASFG_2024-01-22_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDgzNjUzN2QtNTViOS1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzN2RhIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=oyCTzDJC2AC7hcix0ufEbfAEPNYvZXJWO-BfkQn9yac=)

| Peter,

Today marks the 51st anniversary of _Roe v. Wade_ , the Supreme Court case that protected abortion access as a constitutional right for almost half a century.

But today, we’re seeing the heartbreaking aftermath of the _Dobbs_ decision, which overturned _Roe v. Wade_. We’ve seen extreme abortion bans passed in legislatures across the country, women have been denied emergency medical treatments, and some hospitals are no longer providing emergency contraception to women.

Even with extreme bans in place across the South, some lawmakers are going even further to punish and threaten women and doctors with jail time for performing or receiving an abortion.

And now, in a few months, the Supreme Court will decide on further limits on access to the widely used abortion pill, Mifepristone.

**Virginia isn’t immune to these attacks, either.** Governor Glenn Youngkin has said he’d sign any bill “happily and gleefully” to restrict abortion access in Virginia.

Thanks to our small but mighty Democratic majorities in our state legislature, Virginia remains the only state in the South that hasn’t further restricted abortion or women’s healthcare access since the _Dobbs_ decision. We must now elect a governor who will join them in protecting reproductive rights and the health of women.

[_**As Governor of Virginia, I will always protect women’s reproductive rights, but I need your help to get there. Will you contribute to our campaign today to elect a pro-choice Governor of Virginia in 2025?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77540599/450723087/1993432125?refcode=BLU_EM_ASFG_2024-01-22_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDgzNjUzN2QtNTViOS1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzN2RhIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=oyCTzDJC2AC7hcix0ufEbfAEPNYvZXJWO-BfkQn9yac=)

This is a solemn day, friend.

**It has been 51 years since the landmark _Roe v. Wade_ decision became law.**

_Roe_ guaranteed women a right to choose. For nearly 50 years, all women across the country – regardless of their state or zip code – had autonomy over their own bodies.

When _Roe_ fell two years ago, I was marching in the streets because I could not believe that my daughters and granddaughters would grow up with less rights than I did.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77540718/450723548/-315634858?refcode=em-1.22.24-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYwODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjQ0N2JjMTUtNTZiOS1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzN2RhIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=m8TykXrc-ZLEmBPrOcdwrJTTgX6XUZoCnFh0nKiIRHk=&emci=cc94bd66-55b9-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&emdi=6447bc15-56b9-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&ceid=626985)
With _Roe v. Wade_ overturned, women no longer have rights over our own bodies. And our healthcare decisions are no longer just between us and our doctors.

Right-wing courts stripped this fundamental right away. And Republicans like our opponent David Schweikert cheered it on, calling for a national abortion ban with no exceptions for rape or incest.

We need more fighters, team. Abortion will be on the ballot here in Arizona, and I will work tirelessly to protect the rights of my girls.

**[The overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ is one of the reasons I decided to run for Congress, because I knew we had to restore our rights. We must pass the abortion initiative in Arizona and codify _Roe v. Wade_ into law. clean_body: | = This is a solemn day, friend. It has been 51 years since the landmark Roe v. Wade decision became law. Roe guaranteed women a right to choose. For nearly 50 years, all women across the country – regardless of their state or zip code – had autonomy over their own bodies. When Roe fell two years ago, I was marching in the streets because I could not believe that my daughters and granddaughters would grow up with less rights than I did. With Roe v. Wade overturned, women no longer have rights over our own bodies. And our healthcare decisions are no longer just between us and our doctors. Right-wing courts stripped this fundamental right away. And Republicans like our opponent David Schweikert cheered it on, calling for a national abortion ban with no exceptions for rape or incest. We need more fighters, team. Abortion will be on the ballot here in Arizona, and I will work tirelessly to protect the rights of my girls. | ** Thank you for standing with me, Marlene =** | Marlene's campaign to flip AZ-01 is being built from the ground up with grassroots support! = To learn more about Marlene and how she's fighting for Arizona families, please visit: We'd hate to see you go, but you can click here if you'd like to . body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c37301e42bd04129bfdad2f99259964a&_e=BX3pTe9aOIH-gDysF1-JQrCcu4rxfBDMJuMUV_STOR7givHpPaLrnNQHGoZ3OB3jG_nOX_O35844mstdOv1y1BLHxw2YHCOQ2j7g22lCbl94XFDdDDrBvsWtUFcbITzMsooG0LpEhRMC_AhMQdlZDzXuz71awrkD-VpRoQ56vksoGGkK7kx_hGUPcgKZB0u-mIDCwwwueb9G5iHZ8P05GgtJB8Z7dAbqqhIk8MHWqX-QdR1LeCrm58iJAntSJwjdYWZLL4vDpaDHZg5c351_DxKMv0ep-G_YogxmqOHMUvqt6Q3fwG514xdNU1_35eA9SEN_rJhAS7r5ftV90skDTfU_4nsIViYwPKJ8paCjsWniOtYE9h9GeGaQwWYFOMG30e6bnO7K6j5qkVzqxsxj_g%3D%3D) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c37301e42bd04129bfdad2f99259964a&_e=BX3pTe9aOIH-gDysF1-JQrCcu4rxfBDMJuMUV_STOR7givHpPaLrnNQHGoZ3OB3jG_nOX_O35844mstdOv1y1BLHxw2YHCOQ2j7g22lCbl94XFDdDDrBvsWtUFcbITzMsooG0LpEhRMC_AhMQdlZDzXuz71awrkD-VpRoQ56vksoGGkK7kx_hGUPcgKZB0u-mIDCwwwueb9G5iHZ8P05GgtJB8Z7dAbqqhIk8MHWqX8yq_5Iogc5iFiiCNzEpBqBvzG0StSl-M7k9nKmVI_ml2FEvBAvEFVyEDsGVxsdSgEG0lKWrT9wI3mrHRWIy9vQMHVMEwevJ7h-iCQpEV8nbXJkleQzIlx3RRiCX0tTWG_TmVbeD83IsurNJRUFv2ZW8j--srmWpsysw-09NfL8DA%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c37301e42bd04129bfdad2f99259964a&_e=BX3pTe9aOIH-gDysF1-JQrCcu4rxfBDMJuMUV_STOR7givHpPaLrnNQHGoZ3OB3jG_nOX_O35844mstdOv1y1BLHxw2YHCOQ2j7g22lCbl94XFDdDDrBvsWtUFcbITzMsooG0LpEhRMC_AhMQdlZDzXuz71awrkD-VpRoQ56vksoGGkK7kx_hGUPcgKZB0u-mIDCwwwueb9G5iHZ8P05GgtJB8Z7dAbqqhIk8MHWqX9yQgBcCRuqxgLuxA1ADDte1pBr0u43CCoFmOJjb1C5DSR0FCL2eG068d_uSTrT8M8q0-xAq8ZmKeKHAm1WPkGrztepm3oNS2lELHuWGqKhPO8Dd2z9uzhD_TWbfRhrs4dUwaKFF57qlMY-N3Ba2y2MtYK9s6nphNdRSPSI-J9e9g%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. body:
#
Hey Derek, it’s John.
Today is what *should* be the 51st anniversary of Roe v. Wade — but the Supreme Court overturned that decision and allowed millions of people’s rights to be torn away nearly two years ago.
Since Roe was overturned by the Supreme Court + its three Trump-appointed justices, many states have banned abortion. MILLIONS of women lost power over their own bodies + their own lives. Some have even had to flee their home states to receive *life-saving* medical care.
_It didn’t have to be like this._
My promise to you today is the same as it has been since we first started our campaign for Senate: **I’ll *always* be the 51st Democratic vote to abolish the filibuster + codify the protections of Roe into law. But we need to protect PA to make that happen.**

body:
Roe was the floor. We need to build a new ceiling. |
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/77541078/450724780/1237601583?refcode=WTEFEM39_20240122_EllenRoe_v1s2&sourceid=1052727&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NzQ0NDk0Ni01N2I5LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=febZylOCasYYPlKZ6Y75rGCZUq2YwRJttbELLGm0ZBw=) I am furious that we had more rights in 1973 than we have today. But I am also hopeful, because we have something that didn't exist yet in 1973: We have the millions-strong community of EMILYs List candidates and supporters. We have a movement.

**Be part of the movement to STOP anti-choice extremism and SAVE reproductive rights. Donate to EMILYs List now:** | [CONTRIBUTE](https://click.everyaction.com/k/77541079/450724781/1237601583?refcode=WTEFEM39_20240122_EllenRoe_v1s2&sourceid=1052727&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NzQ0NDk0Ni01N2I5LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=febZylOCasYYPlKZ6Y75rGCZUq2YwRJttbELLGm0ZBw=)
---
Peter,

Two big things have stayed with me for the last 51 years, since _Roe v. Wade_ was decided on this day in 1973.

First: The decision was momentous, an event to be celebrated, and _permanent_. In other words, when the U.S. Supreme Court issued its decision confirming a constitutional right to bodily autonomy, **it was unfathomable to think that the precedent set that day could be ignored or invalidated at _any_ point in the future**. If you had told me then that women in 2024 would have fewer rights than we had in 1973, I would have been shocked... and _very, very angry_.

Second: _Roe_ was so important for _everyone_ of childbearing age — but the deepest reaction came from anyone who had gone through the process of getting an abortion pre-_Roe_. I've talked to women who had horrible experiences in dark and dirty hidden "medical" offices, who dealt with serious health problems caused by the procedure, who were terrified others would find out. The trauma of needing care in a country that outlawed it has stayed with them, which is why the women who still live with those memories are some of the most ardent warriors in today's pro-choice movement. Those of us who were alive pre-_Roe_ are DETERMINED that young women will not have to undergo similar terrible experiences.

| | **[Today, I'm asking you to help me defeat the radical Adam Schiff for a seat in the United States Senate.](http://links.gopmembership.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=2278b258e6fc4a4dad435c5e24f1db9a&_e=Azo3l-ZEHAdJO0Kin5r9iGr6YYaWH8qhc-exZ3069etJ0yJx-oWk39W9dot29nKJx_ooSSlMY1fjDP7_oySEk6crOZRFHznL6SrhcWX9FtdMtQLPznNSjaiJ9NyxdQkzeVFQFlPGHahSypowpAdrZI8wzkALiC9qKxT13rAUgkBCfeBWbOdsbwVtjVEeuQw3IJq6Xx7XmtZbWG-XWu3lG8pf1aMC4-DQF9q0QrKmfH0fFknxjZUtC-PCXdgbN1x0i-A6OqK0-dNlSkL-1n0CgOGmSyaop2UWvM9NeqdE6MfHH1y5URtjKqbrcZyJ1ZRh34lTYMaKfexXNg52l4YDFcuh4Mq4oLEHT4ubZ246JbqYiZ6z1KiP5_gJJwxnE4ujQL07dwJbsSOAjPw6p-waWg%3D%3D)** Democrat policies have brought America to its knees. There's fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding and for the first time causing more people to leave California. Joe Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don't care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and dependent. And that's why I'm running for Senate. **We Republicans pulled our country out of the 1970 's Democratic malaise by electing Ronald Reagan.** And I believe we can do it again by putting classic conservative values at the heart of everything we do. But there is no way I can pull it off without you. **[**Will you rush a contribution to my campaign of $15 or more today?**](http://links.gopmembership.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=2278b258e6fc4a4dad435c5e24f1db9a&_e=Azo3l-ZEHAdJO0Kin5r9iGr6YYaWH8qhc-exZ3069etJ0yJx-oWk39W9dot29nKJx_ooSSlMY1fjDP7_oySEk6crOZRFHznL6SrhcWX9FtdMtQLPznNSjaiJ9NyxdQkzeVFQFlPGHahSypowpAdrZI8wzkALiC9qKxT13rAUgkBCfeBWbOdsbwVtjVEeuQw3IJq6Xx7XmtZbWG-XWu3lG8pf1aMC4-DQF9q0QrKmfH1SZNfI9PQeWgfqPXdPGyartnrkvkbk5vdiO7RjeqdGV3PCrA7asWi7kyrPNCLFU6NRIpvE100ewFKTkDo0vBHvkuyWJN--8bERD2H91b9bo6xlOxD9htwfS5keS8pBfNw4ucXb4DufK7si_Znm8oCzbWGrtm9SQ1YlsbNqcwZihQ%3D%3D)** The California primary is coming up in fast on March 5th and I need to have as many conservative Republican's like you on my side as possible. In California's primary the top two vote-getters make it to the general election. And right now the polls show Adam Schiff polling at #1 and I'm hot on his heels at #2. Once we're passed the primary, I know with your help, I can beat him in November. Why? First... I've lived and worked in California for over 50 years, and I can tell you -\- voters here have had it with the Democrats like I've never seen before. They are hungry for change, and if you and I work together to reach voters in every neighborhood, on every beach, in every corner of California... I know we can turn this historic opportunity into a **Republican win**. I'm fighting for the soul of the state I love -- but make no mistake -- I'm not just taking the field for Californians. When we win here... when we rip this seat out the hands of the radical Adam Schiff... **...we start the nationwide Republican Comeback Rally our country desperately needs.** Thank you and God Bless,

Friend, today marks the 51st anniversary of Roe v. Wade.

Friend, today marks the 51st anniversary of Roe v. Wade _._
This should be a day when we celebrate how far our country has come. But instead, since 2022, a few out-of-touch extremists have undone half a century of progress, pushing us back to an era of radical, dangerous bans.
Looking at the state of reproductive rights in states like Florida, I'm furious and heartbroken. We've lost so much with these bans. We have fewer rights and zero bodily autonomy. But I refuse to give up this fight because I know that this is a fight we must win _._
**Ever since the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade _,_ we've watched voters come together to _reject_ the GOP's far-right bans.** And it's not just happening in blue states: Even in states like Virginia, Kansas, and Kentucky, pro-choice leaders have celebrated incredible wins. Now, Florida is next.
Democrats here just flipped a critical state House district blue by running a proudly pro-choice campaign. And now, activists have secured enough signatures to put an abortion rights ballot initiative to a vote this November.
**Here in Florida, and all across the country, voters have a message for anti-choice extremists: Enough is enough._Ya no más._**
We are the majority. But we have to make sure that we are louder, and stronger, than the far-right radicals fighting to push us backward. **[Please, will you sign my petition before midnight tonight to honor the anniversary of Roe v. Catch my Indy Star interview, insights on Axe The Tax, and highlights from a week filled with energizing events and key endorsements!

https://www.crouchforindiana.com/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8a8e108d6b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_15_04_07&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8a8e108d6b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Friends and fellow Hoosiers,

It's been another great week on the campaign trail! I️ met with the media for an engaging Q&A on the issues (https://www.indystar.com/story/news/politics/elections/2024/01/10/2024-indiana-governor-race-qa-with-lt-gov-suzanne-crouch/71800652007/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8a8e108d6b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_15_04_07&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8a8e108d6b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) and wrote an Op-Ed (https://www.tribstar.com/opinion/flashpoint/flashpoint-eliminating-income-tax-would-boost-indianas-economy/article_26b30ab4-a9a0-11ee-ae5d-13e78cb51823.html?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8a8e108d6b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_15_04_07&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8a8e108d6b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) about how Axe The Tax will benefit Hoosier families and bolster our economy. Plus, I️ attended several events and had the honor of receiving multiple new endorsements!

Read on for the highlights!

** IN THE NEWS: Eliminating income tax would boost Indiana's economy (https://www.tribstar.com/opinion/flashpoint/flashpoint-eliminating-income-tax-would-boost-indianas-economy/article_26b30ab4-a9a0-11ee-ae5d-13e78cb51823.html?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8a8e108d6b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_15_04_07&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8a8e108d6b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

Indiana's budget has risen by 50% in the last decade. We can, and we must reel it in.

My plan to #AxeTheTax (https://www.facebook.com/hashtag/axethetax?__eep__=6&__cft__[0]=AZWYI5iqMMzEO000mCvBQL1zNyEEhiFwZkU3xYhCxIHQ69hN14iw1YC56Kx3o6OAUVTHarGxGFHwVl731fRQu7Lf6kA0XGTgzBJp1233Ai71I5jANHTdddQr0W5SQl6iFfFHJeicTCEAaVAXwQmcMAjAE8q_JaNO2Ua-CSW1uXXnCQ1EY_IIyQwhONx2SZSWFAE&__tn__=*NK-R&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8a8e108d6b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_15_04_07&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8a8e108d6b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) would:
✅ Limit government growth
✅ Attract new talent to Indiana
✅ Provide much-needed relief to Hoosiers feeling the pinch of Bidenflation
https://www.tribstar.com/opinion/flashpoint/flashpoint-eliminating-income-tax-would-boost-indianas-economy/article_26b30ab4-a9a0-11ee-ae5d-13e78cb51823.html?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8a8e108d6b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_15_04_07&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8a8e108d6b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

body:
Dear Supporter,
I'll be attending SHOT Show this week in Las Vegas and want to invite you to a VIP Reception in a beautiful suite with me and other influential 2A advocates on Wednesday evening.
Tickets are available at [https://BrandonHerreraforCongress.com/SHOTShow](https://contact.brandonherreraforcongress.com/l/6fI53a1vdu7637OWRF387YCA/3cBqzrqSrtlxjWjVsMHNdg/HS4x3qLoRuFPpg2aiELfOg).
The good news is that thanks to the support of donors like you, we've begun to deploy yard signs all over the district.
The bad news is that we're still short of our fundraising goal to be able to get our message out to all of the Republican Primary voters through mail, digital, texting, calls, and television.
Can you help me out by chipping in a contribution at https://BrandonHerreraforCongress.com/Donate?
My opponent Tony Gonzales says he's a "Republican" despite:
* Opposing the revival of President Trump's border security strategy to prevent migrants and fentanyl from flooding into our country.
* Voting for the National Vaccine Tracking Database.
* Voting to fund Red Flag laws and new gun control at the state level.
* Voting to force local police departments to enforce federal gun control laws.
* Voting to continue warrantless wiretaps of US citizens.
* Sending $40 billion to defend Ukraine's border while ours remains wide open.
* Keeping US troops in harm's way in the Middle East where they serve no direct national interest.

We have a great chance of retiring him and replacing him on March 5th - but only if we can make sure the Republican primary voters know what you know: that he's betrayed our values and that I'm the candidate they can trust to uphold them.
Please make a donation today at [https://BrandonHerreraforCongress.com](https://contact.brandonherreraforcongress.com/l/6fI53a1vdu7637OWRF387YCA/SvuzsT4WgoVSJzTl1ktxcw/HS4x3qLoRuFPpg2aiELfOg).
**And as a little extra incentive, I 'll give one lucky donor my AKG Built Tantal AK-47 in 5.45.** Every $5 you contribute will earn you an entry. I've already given away one rifle and one trip to a range day in San Antonio, and I can't wait to notify the next winner.
Thanks for all your help.
Respectfully,

Brandon Herrera

name: Georgia House Democrats
subject: Denying rights to women.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Georgia Blue PAC
body:
Peter:

Three GOP Supreme Court justices were confirmed after proclaiming that Roe v. Wade was “settled law.” Of course we know what happened after they donned their robes and took their lifetime seats: they overturned Roe v. Wade and stripped women of the right to make their own healthcare decisions.

The results for Georgia have been disastrous. Our state already had the worst maternal mortality rate in the nation. Approximately half of all counties in Georgia have no OB physician, and 40+ counties have no obstetrical care of any kind. Georgia’s near-total abortion ban means that doctors and other healthcare providers are unlikely to return to these areas anytime soon.

Stripping half the population of human rights is a despicable way to govern. How much more do we have to endure? By supporting Georgia Democrats, you can help put us back on the right path, where all Georgians are equal. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gahouse-grassroots2?refcode=012224_RoeVWade_link]

On the anniversary of this landmark Roe v. Wade decision, join us to help restore the right to healthcare for all women.

Donate $10 Today [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gahouse-grassroots2?refcode=012224_RoeVWade_button1]

Donate $25 Today [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gahouse-grassroots2?refcode=012224_RoeVWade_button2]

Donate $50 Today [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gahouse-grassroots2?refcode=012224_RoeVWade_button3]

Onwards,

Georgia House Democrats

OUR AGENDA

Every day, we're fighting for a better Georgia for hard-working families like yours. To learn more, visit us here [https://gahousedems.com/agenda/?refcode=email-footer-agenda].

HEALTHCARE: We must expand Medicaid to keep our hospitals open and ensure every Georgian can see a doctor when they're sick.

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1052%2E135344%2E3iw7uX)

Friends -
Today should mark 51 years since the protections of Roe v. Wade took effect.
Instead, because of the Dobbs decision in June 2022, millions of American women have fewer rights now than their mothers & grandmothers had.
Since the fall of Roe at the federal level, the issue of abortion has been left to the states. Here in Michigan, voters overwhelmingly voted for a ballot initiative in 2022 that codified the Roe standard into our state Constitution, and repealed a 1931 ban that made it a felony to administer most abortions, including for rape or incest. And Governor Whitmer signed an executive directive further protecting women who seek to access their fundamental reproductive rights.
But if you think far-right Republicans are done attacking abortion at the federal level after the Dobbs decision overturned Roe, think again.
Over the past year, the Republican-led House has tee’d up 15 votes meant to shut down some form of federal abortion access. They include repeated attempts to ban women in the military from crossing state lines when an abortion wasn’t available near their base; restrict access to Mifepristone; and divert funds to organizations that spread misleading information about reproductive health. Just last week, we voted on two bills aimed at restricting access to abortion: One would divert federal health care funding to “pregnancy centers” that refuse to provide information on abortion, and have been found to provide deceptive information to women. And a second would restrict the information on choice made available to college students who become pregnant.
So what does this mean? It means that the Republican Party is hellbent in going after each and every possible angle to stop women from access to abortion, even in the case of rape or incest.
And in June, we will see another landmark case on this issue play out as the Supreme Court decides whether or not it’s legal to mail mifepristone across state lines – a safe and legal drug that has been widely used for over two decades for women having miscarriages, D&Cs;, medically necessary terminations and abortions. This case could ban the mailing of the drug even to states run by Democrats, making it extremely difficult to get an abortion, even where it’s legal.
With these salami tactics–in legislation, appropriation, and in state law–the GOP continues to prove what we’ve always known: Dobbs was the beginning, not the end.
If Republicans are able to take back the White House and the Senate this November, a federal abortion ban will be on the table -- and access everywhere will be at risk, even in states like Michigan that have taken action to protect the right to choose.
Those are very much the stakes in this election.
But we cannot do that alone. Those who want to continue the fight against access to abortion know how important it is as well – and you can bet they'll be spending huge sums of money to defeat us. Which is why I am asking for your help today:

| Peter,

This week, we should be celebrating the 51st anniversary of _Roe v. Wade_ , the landmark Supreme Court case that protected abortion access as a constitutional right for almost half a century.

name: Alexandria
subject: Hi, I’m Allyson’s mom
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Allyson for Congress
body:
Hey there, I’m Allyson’s mother, Alexandria.

Allyson is the eldest of four. And I can tell you firsthand, she’s been a fighter her whole life.

For most of my life, we didn’t have much. My own mother knocked on doors to sell tortillas with my sisters and I so we could afford to put food on the table. Years later, I remember making the same tortillas and filling them with beans and rice for Allyson and her brothers to eat. It wasn’t a lot, but we made the best of what we had.

Allyson worked hard in school and became an engineer. She met her husband Marc (also an engineer) and they started a family together. When it became clear that her daughters needed her full-time support she didn’t return to her career in order to care for them. She went head to head with massive health insurance and drug companies to get her daughters the life-saving care they needed – and she won.

Now she’s running for Congress and every day, I’m seeing her talk to voters and listen to them with the same care and kindness she gives to her family.

I wanted to personally reach out to you and ask if you can contribute any amount to her campaign today and help bring her vision of leading by compassion and integrity to Congress.

CONTRIBUTE ANY AMOUNT >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_email_2024q1?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2024.01.22_B2_AllysonMom_FriendsAndFamilyList]

Friends, I come from a big family. I’m one of 10 children. I’m sure you can imagine that it can be a little hectic with so many voices in the house. But I always taught Allyson what my parents taught me: the importance of listening first.

And she’s carried on this lesson in her public service on the Tustin School Board.

I’m confident she will carry it in Congress as well. Right now she needs our help to help make it happen. Please contribute any amount today and let’s help Allyson in her campaign for Congress!

CONTRIBUTE ANY AMOUNT >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_email_2024q1?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2024.01.22_B2_AllysonMom_FriendsAndFamilyList]

Thank you for hearing me out, team.

– Alexandria

Peter – Today marks the 51st anniversary of _Roe v. Wade,_ where the Supreme Court recognized a woman’s constitutional right to have an abortion. And, if you’re anything like me, today your inbox is overflowing with Democrats running for office promising to fight to restore abortion rights for American women. That’s a good thing. It means Democrats are united in this work. But, as the old saying goes, “If you want to know where someone is going, look at where they’ve been.” The fight to protect abortion rights didn’t start last year. From George W. Bush to John McCain to Mitt Romney to Donald Trump, Republican presidential candidates told us exactly what they would do: appoint Supreme Court justices who would overturn _Roe v. Wade_ and push for a Constitutional amendment to ban abortion. _And I fought them every step of the way._ Arizona Republican Governor Jan Brewer signed what Planned Parenthood called the “most extreme abortion ban in the United States.” _And as Chair of the Arizona Democratic Party, I helped lead the fight against her._ **If Democrats are going to win the fight for reproductive freedom, we need leaders who have fought against the Republican politicians who appointed and voted for the Supreme Court Justices who overturned _Roe v. Wade_ – not those who were AWOL or even on the other side.** For me, the fight to protect the assault on women’s rights to control their own bodies isn’t a new one. It’s been a fight I’ve been waging for decades. [**Will you join me in the fight to protect access to abortion in Arizona and around the country? Your contribution will directly impact our ability to effect positive change and uphold reproductive rights.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77546413/450744062/-677050522?refcode=AU_AHC_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240122_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmQ3MTA3MmUtNjNiOS1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzN2RhIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=-bQyG_FEqYX4YJxGG5Wa-SFXSFPPOYZcM88wb0R28HE=) My opponent, David Schweikert, has made opposition to reproductive rights a core crusade during his time in Congress.
* ❌ He is pushing a bill to ban abortion nationwide with no exceptions;
* ❌ He voted against the right to contraception;
* ❌ He even voted to allow states to __**prosecute women**__ traveling out of state to receive an abortion.

**We must fight back.** If elected to serve in Congress, I’ll take immediate action to enshrine the right to reproductive health care into law once and for all. That’s what I did as a CEO when, in the wake of the ruling overturning _Roe v. Wade,_ I ensured that our employees would have access to reproductive health services no matter where in America they lived. But, I cannot protect abortion access alone. I need your support. body:
| | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/7595fabbe948/icymi-john-teicherts-vision-for-marylands-senate-on-fox-6689714?e=1b1fb1ad9f)
---
Welcome to Teichert on the Trail, our weekly email highlighting the latest news and events from the campaign as Brigadier General (ret) Teichert earns the hearts, minds, and votes of Marylanders in the race to be their next U.S. Senator.
**Teichert in the News**
[](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=08b7901d2e&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
On Thursday, January 18th, Brigadier General (ret) Teichert rolled out the[ Law Enforcement for Teichert ](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=79b6535320&e=1b1fb1ad9f)Coalition, the newest coalition amid his bid for U.S. Senate. Speaking at the press conference were Sheriff Joe Gamble of Talbot County and Sheriff Matthew Crisafulli of Worcester County. Teichert opened the event by saying, “Unfortunately here in Maryland, and in many places around our country, our politicians, including my opponents, are saying just the opposite of that. They're saying to law enforcement, we don't trust you, we don't appreciate you and we won't fully support you. And as a result, we see these pro criminal policies that ultimately degrade law and order in our communities and ignore the needs of the community and law abiding citizens.”
[](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=956bdc1033&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
On Friday, General Teichert joined Tom Rodgers on[ Fox 45](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=8eaa908e2b&e=1b1fb1ad9f) to discuss his top priorities as a candidate for the U.S. Senate in Maryland. When discussing the educational crisis in Maryland and across the country, Teichert said in part, “We need school choice. We need parents to be able to make the decision about what type of schooling situation is best for their children.."

[](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=70f6d26cec&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
On Monday, January 15th, General Teichert joined [China Unscripted](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=e757c664bc&e=1b1fb1ad9f) to discuss American infighting and the threatening nature of China’s position towards the United States. When speaking about unconventional war between the U.S. and China, Teichert said, “look back to $700 B of American stolen intellectual property a year- that has a real impact on our country. Or Chinese communist clubs in U.S. colleges. Or Chinese police stations in major U.S. cities. Or the spy balloon fiasco from a year ago. Or encircling the United States with spy stations like the one that currently is stood up in Cuba. Those are examples that are far short of conventional war, but are starting to erode America’s ability to allow the international order to remain that has benefited humanity since the end of World War II that is free, open, prosperous, and secure.”
[](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=0374f8cff7&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
John also joined Rich Valdés on [America at Night ](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=ecb8e0b566&e=1b1fb1ad9f)to discuss the recent Houthi attacks in the Red Sea, America’s defensive strategy, and the generals’ bid for the U.S. Senate. The general stated in part, “Every single response we've seen from America in the last 3 years- and whether it’s leaving Afghanistan in a feckless way, or very hesitant responses around Ukraine or in the Western Pacific- all of it has revolved around the President being extremely concerned that American strength will actually cause escalation and aggression. And we've just seen time and again that the less America is willing to respond, the more likely it is that we will face aggression- and not the other way around.”
[](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=b445afaab0&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
On Tuesday, General Teichert joined Nicole Berlie on [News Nation](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=3917b08ff1&e=1b1fb1ad9f) to discuss Putin’s alleged plan to lead Russia into a world war- and how it would impact the United States. Teichert stated in part, “Ultimately, Article V of the North Atlantic treaty would prompt all N.A.T.O members to come to the support of one attacked N.A.T.O member, but ultimately, if you look what's going on in Ukraine, Russia cannot even subdue that one small non-N.A.T.O member. It makes it far less likely that he's going to have this large strategic surprise to do something far more grandiose- and something that he’s failed to do thus far.”
|

Teichert in the News On Thursday, January 18th, Brigadier General (ret) Teichert rolled out the, the newest coalition amid his bid for U.S. Senate. Speaking at the press conference were Sheriff Joe Gamble of Talbot County and Sheriff Matthew Crisafulli of Worcester County. Teichert opened the event by saying, “Unfortunately here in Maryland, and in many places around our country, our politicians, including my opponents, are saying just the opposite of that. They're saying to law enforcement, we don't trust you, we don't appreciate you and we won't fully support you. And as a result, we see these pro criminal policies that ultimately degrade law and order in our communities and ignore the needs of the community and law abiding citizens.” On Friday, General Teichert joined Tom Rodgers on to discuss his top priorities as a candidate for the U.S. Senate in Maryland. When discussing the educational crisis in Maryland and across the country, Teichert said in part, “We need school choice. We need parents to be able to make the decision about what type of schooling situation is best for their children.." On Monday, January 15th, General Teichert joined to discuss American infighting and the threatening nature of China’s position towards the United States. When speaking about unconventional war between the U.S. and China, Teichert said, “look back to $700 B of American stolen intellectual property a year- that has a real impact on our country. Or Chinese communist clubs in U.S. colleges. Or Chinese police stations in major U.S. cities. Or the spy balloon fiasco from a year ago. Or encircling the United States with spy stations like the one that currently is stood up in Cuba. Those are examples that are far short of conventional war, but are starting to erode America’s ability to allow the international order to remain that has benefited humanity since the end of World War II that is free, open, prosperous, and secure.” John also joined Rich Valdés on discuss the recent Houthi attacks in the Red Sea, America’s defensive strategy, and the generals’ bid for the U.S. Senate. The general stated in part, “Every single response we've seen from America in the last 3 years- and whether it’s leaving Afghanistan in a feckless way, or very hesitant responses around Ukraine or in the Western Pacific- all of it has revolved around the President being extremely concerned that American strength will actually cause escalation and aggression. And we've just seen time and again that the less America is willing to respond, the more likely it is that we will face aggression- and not the other way around.” On Tuesday, General Teichert joined Nicole Berlie on to discuss Putin’s alleged plan to lead Russia into a world war- and how it would impact the United States. Teichert stated in part, “Ultimately, Article V of the North Atlantic treaty would prompt all N.A.T.O members to come to the support of one attacked N.A.T.O member, but ultimately, if you look what's going on in Ukraine, Russia cannot even subdue that one small non-N.A.T.O member. It makes it far less likely that he's going to have this large strategic surprise to do something far more grandiose- and something that he’s failed to do thus far.” | Teichert on the Trail | | | | | | | | | | | Thoughts by Teichert January 17th, John Teichert celebrated International Mentoring Day by sharing why mentoring is crucial to reviving a fundamentally strong and capable America. subject: Today is a reminder that we all need to remain steadfast and determined in our fight to restore abortion rights
disclaimer_text: Paid for by The Long Run PAC, P
body:
#
Friends,
_Roe v. Wade_ was decided 51 years ago today. It was a monumental day in our nation's history when the Supreme Court of the United States ruled that women had a right to choose.
But in June of 2022, the conservative majority on the Supreme Court overturned _Roe_ and robbed reproductive freedom from millions nationwide.
We have seen the catastrophic damages this decision has caused all over the country. Abortion clinics are overwhelmed in blue states and women are being refused vital care in red ones.
Just recently, a Texas woman was denied an abortion for her high-risk pregnancy and was forced to seek care in a different state to save her life. And here in Wisconsin, Republicans have fought to keep Wisconsin’s draconian 1849 ban on abortion in place and since a court ruled the law unconstitutional, they just introduced a 14-week abortion ban.
This issue is personal. My mother had a complicated pregnancy that put her health at risk. But she had a choice and decided to end the pregnancy. Now, many women in the same situation are being denied that same lifesaving option.
The past few years have been a constant battle for women, doctors, and advocates nationwide. But today is a reminder that we all need to remain steadfast and determined in this fight because _**we collectively have the power to restore abortion rights._**
And it starts with you and me, making sure we elect pro-choice Democrats up and down the ballot nationwide this November.
We can’t let Trump pursue a nationwide abortion ban or pack the Supreme Court with more anti-abortion conservative justices.
We need to reelect Tammy Baldwin and Jon Tester and help Colin Allred flip Texas’ seat to protect our Senate majority and vote to restore abortion access everywhere.
And we need to elect folks like Will Rollins, Sarah Klee Hood, and Josh Riley so we can take back the House majority and pass reproductive care legislation.
But they can’t do it alone, they need our support.
We know we have the power to win if we have your support. So we are asking: [**So can you please contribute $3 or whatever you can afford to The Long Run so we can continue supporting pro-choice Democrats up and down the ballot nationwide? Every donation will help us fund and provide resources to candidates in critical races.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-jan24.Ibl7yb&refcode=em240122-1-t1&t=1&akid=5164%2E196590%2E1MBmh-)

clean_body: Friends, Roe v. Wade was decided 51 years ago today. It was a monumental day in our nation's history when the Supreme Court of the United States ruled that women had a right to choose. But in June of 2022, the conservative majority on the Supreme Court overturned Roe and robbed reproductive freedom from millions nationwide. We have seen the catastrophic damages this decision has caused all over the country. Abortion clinics are overwhelmed in blue states and women are being refused vital care in red ones. Just recently, a Texas woman was denied an abortion for her high-risk pregnancy and was forced to seek care in a different state to save her life. And here in Wisconsin, Republicans have fought to keep Wisconsin’s draconian 1849 ban on abortion in place and since a court ruled the law unconstitutional, they just introduced a 14-week abortion ban. This issue is personal. My mother had a complicated pregnancy that put her health at risk. But she had a choice and decided to end the pregnancy. Now, many women in the same situation are being denied that same lifesaving option. The past few years have been a constant battle for women, doctors, and advocates nationwide. But today is a reminder that we all need to remain steadfast and determined in this fight because we collectively have the power to restore abortion rights. And it starts with you and me, making sure we elect pro-choice Democrats up and down the ballot nationwide this November. We can’t let Trump pursue a nationwide abortion ban or pack the Supreme Court with more anti-abortion conservative justices. We need to reelect Tammy Baldwin and Jon Tester and help Colin Allred flip Texas’ seat to protect our Senate majority and vote to restore abortion access everywhere. And we need to elect folks like Will Rollins, Sarah Klee Hood, and Josh Riley so we can take back the House majority and pass reproductive care legislation. I have 15 minutes of free time before my next debate prep, Peter. It may not sound like much — but I’ve been working long hours in Congress to avoid a government shutdown, and any gap in my schedule is rare.

So, as I’m checking in with my wife, Eve, and catching up on some emails, I’m reflecting on this campaign — the most competitive California has seen in three decades — and I’ve decided I need to tell you a bit more about my decision to run for U.S. Senate.

Throughout my time as an assistant U.S. attorney, California state Senator, and member of Congress, I’ve always tried to do the most good for the most people. There is a tenet I’ve carried with me that is central to my Jewish faith — “Tikkun Olam.” Repairing the world.

Lately, there’s been a lot that has broken, and a lot to fix. It’s been my cause. It’s why I get up in the morning.

When Speaker Nancy Pelosi tasked me with investigating and impeaching Donald Trump. When she asked me to help investigate the Capitol insurrection on the January 6 Committee. I’ve carried that with me.

I’ve carried it with me on this campaign, too. People struggling to afford the cost of living and or sending their kids to daycare or college. People struggling to afford their medications. People worrying about what our climate will look like ten, twenty years from now as we are routinely ravaged by drought, mudslides, and wildfires today.

Yes, there is a lot that is broken. And there’s a lot to fix.

But there’s also a lot of good in the world, too. The people I’ve met on the campaign trail remind me why this work is so important. And the people like you, supporting this campaign a couple bucks at a time, so we can do good work.

That’s why I’m running. And now, our primary race is within the margin of error just 5 hours from our first televised debate.

It’s critical that we win this race. We need to abolish the filibuster. Expand the Supreme Court. Overturn _Citizens United._ And protect reproductive freedom.

body:
My father needs a solid Republican Senate Majority to pass his America First agenda. Please step up now to support Senate Republicans in critical races. | Fellow American -

The path to victory in the U.S. Senate leads through key races determining the U.S. Senate Majority. Ten seats are competitive and up for grabs this year. We have a HUGE opportunity to flip the Senate back into Republican control and build a robust Republican Majority.

**We could take all ten,**or we could take 0.**** It will all depend on our efforts leading up to the election and whether we step up for our candidates or watch them fall.

[**Step up with a $10 gift now**](http://links.teamnrsc.co/u/click?_t=aff6d619248e4524b6f468bb9c83f15c&_m=1e0504726ad744cd8d4e7ab6e78f29ba&_e=CKrJpthSJ383qSI9t1QrkgGeB_93CEu9osdIY4xxA1TO_ifvl-HRV8dtwcPcxgi9oAzx5eeKuY4Fau_UXsllVj5AHqGQbAcIiBKi9KYGvkZAGSSwzLBlBnvCXWtrTZJqDEvf6pzWKs30JDecHcM4JRqnfn9RsRmF6012hHSx8l5qb-7pFIZFnRG8lRxQpl5GnMvN4wsQaXlImW7kCqr8B0WJyoMvq3Js4uV4-LN5mFFpMh819c1V5badFPtsQOBnM2kEcslhbEQr4HVi6eI8ildmc3peZbpIqJ_ChRWJjSDViR5AIftmzykKqMvgEkd9sFEHRT4HCYMDdYaI11l3shodajMocbJUiwUYVOu1_kUh0j7slFMfzT2iERutd3hHB7ITJ8Wably--u5qEfkTDo94EBfrv2G__gvC7x5-j04%3D)
Because Democrats will be running smear campaigns in all these competitive races, they will go to their year-in, year-out playbook and attack our candidates personally, trying to drag them and their families through the mud.

But we know it is coming, so we must be prepared. How we best fight back is with our own media campaign to spread the truth to voters about Democrats' dangerous agenda and our incredible conservative candidates for the U.S. Senate.

**And that campaign will be costly, but it is an expense we cannot avoid.** We must punch back when the media starts spreading lies for the Democrat Party and tearing our candidates down to sway elections.

Today’s anniversary reminds us just how important it is to elect leaders who will safeguard a woman’s right to make private decisions about her body.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77547449/450747495/1032217744?refcode=em_fr_2024.01.22_b1_as_all-nd&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNWM1Y2NjMy02OGI5LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0KIYILho97_h9gMV4cEBngBv3yCD19kCvCfdCasGE80=)

Friend, Today we mark the 51st anniversary of _Roe v. Wade_ , the landmark Supreme Court decision that established the right to abortion. For 49 years, _Roe_ affirmed that access to safe, reproductive health care was a right. But in 2022, millions were robbed of their fundamental right to make deeply personal health care decisions. Today, without the protections of _Roe v. Wade_ , Republicans are fighting harder than ever to impose their national abortion ban in every state throughout the country – even Oregon. **Let me be clear: I believe abortion and reproductive health care shouldn’t just be legal, it needs to be affordable and accessible. I’ll never stop fighting to make that a reality.** Today’s anniversary reminds us just how important it is to elect leaders who will safeguard a woman’s right to make private decisions about her body. **[That’s why I hope you’ll contribute to my reelection campaign today – because as long as I’m in Congress, I’ll never stop fighting to protect access to abortion care.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77547450/450747496/1032217744?refcode=em_fr_2024.01.22_b1_as_all-nd&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNWM1Y2NjMy02OGI5LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0KIYILho97_h9gMV4cEBngBv3yCD19kCvCfdCasGE80=) ** | _[Donate>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77547451/450747497/1032217744?refcode=em_fr_2024.01.22_b1_as_all-nd&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNWM1Y2NjMy02OGI5LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0KIYILho97_h9gMV4cEBngBv3yCD19kCvCfdCasGE80=)_

We know that the _Dobbs_ decision was just the beginning, and efforts to restrict access to abortion, birth control and other reproductive care are ongoing. **But no matter what, I’m fighting until women nationwide have access to the abortion care they need.**
Thank you for being in this fight with me,
Andrea Salinas

Wade_. We should be celebrating 51 years of a guaranteed right to abortion care. Instead, because of the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , the right to choose has been attacked – or all out obliterated – in too many states. Here in Virginia, Democrats have stopped the GOP’s attempts to roll-back abortion rights, but we can’t stop until the right to get an abortion is restored for every single American. | | Today is the 51st anniversary of _Roe v. Wade_ , the monumental Supreme Court ruling that gave all Americans legal access to abortion. Instead of celebrating, we're living with the disastrous aftermath of the 2022 ruling by the Court's conservative extremist majority in _Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization_. That decision demolished the constitutional right to an abortion and gave right-wing legislatures across the country the power to impose bans and severe restrictions that put people's lives at risk and punish doctors for providing abortion care. **Nobody wants a politician in the exam room telling a woman or her doctor what to do, especially when making complex decisions about reproductive healthcare.** Yet, that is exactly what the Supreme Court did. It gave legislators hell-bent on restricting access to reproductive health the power to dictate what should be a private medical decision. That's outrageous. **No matter where a woman lives in this country, she should have the right to access the full range of reproductive care.** To make sure that happens, I introduced the _Women's Health Protection Act_ to enshrine abortion rights into federal law. But Republicans – and the filibuster – are standing in the way. That's why I'm focused on holding the Senate Democratic Majority and retaking the House in 2024 so we can restore abortion access for all Americans. Peter Willis,

Over the last two weeks, President Biden has ordered airstrikes in Yemen.
These bombings were unconstitutional AND incredibly reckless — President
Biden is heightening tensions and violence in the Middle East that could
cause the war in Israel and Gaza to expand into a regional conflict.

Rep. Ro Khanna called on President Biden to follow the law and come to
Congress before any further violence in Yemen citing Article I of the U.S.
Constitution and saying, “I will stand up for that regardless of whether a
Democrat or Republican is in the White House.”

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/14191?source=email-20240122&t=1011&akid=5221%2E5885482%2E93f-bz ]Add your name: Peace, not war! It’s time for de-escalation in the
Middle East, not more U.S. bombings. Tell President Biden to stop
airstrikes in Yemen and follow the U.S. Constitution.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/14191?source=email-20240122&t=1012&akid=5221%2E5885482%2E93f-bz ]ADD YOUR NAME

Further U.S. airstrikes in Houthi-held territory in Yemen could lead to
more direct U.S. military involvement in an expanding regional conflict.
That’s unacceptable. It’s past time for peace in Gaza — President Biden
bombing Yemen is not how we achieve a diplomatic ceasefire.

Article I of the Constitution and the War Powers Resolution make it clear:
The president does not have the power to launch a preemptive strike like
this without approval from Congress unless necessitated by a “national
emergency” to defend against an “attack upon the United States, its
territories or possessions, or its armed forces."

Rep. Ro Khanna and other progressive members of Congress like Pramila
Jayapal are right to call out the unconstitutional nature of these
airstrikes. We must work towards peace, not more war.

1. Matt Dolan Takes On China and Pledges to Fight for American Workers in Latest TV Ad.

2. State Leader & Former Findlay Mayor Lydia Mihalik Endorses Matt Dolan for U.S. Senate.

3. Tune in on Monday Evening for the First Ohio Republican U.S. Senate Debate.

_**Matt Dolan Takes On China and Stands Up for American Workers in Latest Statewide TV Ad.**_
* Matt Dolan launched his latest television ad, in which he vows to FIGHT BACK against China, build a stronger Ohio and protect American workers.

* The Chinese Communist Party has stolen our intellectual property and our manufacturing jobs. Now they are buying up our farmland and spying on our kids.

* “As Ohio’s senator, I’ll fight back,” Dolan says. “Bringing our factories and our supply lines home. And protecting American workers. Joe Biden and Sherrod Brown won’t stand up to China. But I will.”

| Friend,
I am hesitant to mention one reason why Valerie and I felt led for me to run for Congress, because we are running in the promise and hope of making America Great Again. But there is a real, urgent and practical concern involving our national security in addition to securing the Open Borders, which is a primary concern especially since today's SCOTUS ruling kicks the Border issue to Congress and allows Biden to remove the Texas razor wire protecting us.

I believe there is little time to protect our nation and our children from the ineptness and vacuum of leadership by the Biden administration right now leading us into a possible extreme and dangerous - possibly nuclear - World War III. _Time is of the essence for peace through __strength leadership, opposing the warmongering industrial state that is pushing for war by willful weakness_.

Recently, I wrote a sub stack article, which I share below, about how the Biden decision to eliminate President Trump's sea-launched missile defense program - greatly increasing our exposure to total destruction of our Navy, and thus opening our homeland to direct attack. This weakness is outrageous.

Don't take it just from me - both a retired US Brigadier General is [confirming this concern echoed just days ago](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=925e2f9b05&e=5bb5efcda7) by NATO that WWIII is on the horizon because of American weakness, as well as President Bill "Epstein Island" Clinton's top and long-time Democrat advisor, Doug Schoen, who [just published an article in The Hill saying just that](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=602411fef1&e=5bb5efcda7). And with Billions of dollars unfrozen as a gift for Iran, what was the Biden result? War and terror in the Middle East at the expense of our men and women in harms way and our ally the people of Israel.

Never has there been a more important time for us to raise a war chest for peace in this race. I believe strongly in Peace through Strength. But I cannot win this seat and be sworn in as your Member of Congress - to fight for peace - [unless I have your timely help for this First Quarter](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=ee185e59b0&e=5bb5efcda7). I need to stay on pace to defeat the far Left.

**_I won't stand by while our inept "leaders" bumble us into WWIII and cost the lives of our children and grandchildren. _**

Thank you for your support and please consider donating at least $25 today to help us reach our goal.

This is our freedom, our families, our children's future at stake. The fate of the world could rest upon Congress' ability to lead. Help me get there and serve.

Freedom and victory,

Dan Cox, Candidate for Congress (R-MD-6)

### War Mongering Biden Canceled President Trump's Sea-Launched Missile Defense Program, Signaling American Weakness
In 2022, I was the sole Maryland State Delegate who walked off the House Floor and refused to vote for a Maryland Resolution to support the Biden administration’s escalation-funding of war in Ukraine. [There were clear indications that a real peace was possible](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=422059c062&e=5bb5efcda7), avoiding many of the now close to 600,000 lives lost or severely injured on both sides of the conflict and the clear likelihood that any western involvement in at times what appears like a WWI-reminiscent trench-based ground war was asinine and would be dangerous for the world. Today, I remain the only candidate for Congress in Maryland’s Sixth District who is calling for Peace Through Strength, rather than the Biden regime’s “War Through Weakness” funding of foreign wars and I am the only one who will not vote to continue funding the War in Ukraine. **Ukrainian soldiers in a trench under Russian shelling close to Bakhmut, Donetsk region, Ukraine, March 5, 2023. (AP Photo/Libkos, File)(FoxNews)** The constitutional duty of the President under the United States’ Constitution, Article IV, sec. 4, is to protect our States from invasion. I was concerned that Biden was opening our own Borders to mass invasion which Americans are now funding at billions of tax dollars a year in services and increased costs, not to mention inflation. And I was concerned that Biden was abandoning our “Peace Through Strength” foreign policy doctrine that has helped advance the peace of Europe since President Reagan brought down the Soviet Empire without firing a shot. Expanding NATO’s borders and disregarding Russia, while also collapsing our own border, is not only bad foreign policy, it is a direct _provoquer la guerre_. Sadly, my concerns were accurate. Last month over 300,000 illegal aliens walked freely into our country and into your neighborhoods with Biden-government-loaded debit cards of your taxpayer dollars for their spending. And now nearly every day the young Ukrainian wife of my close family member posts what appears to be devastating escalations of the war in Ukraine including on her city of Kyiv - the capital, which war you and I as American taxpayers are funding to the tune of over $113 billion to date. And what did we get for our money? Peace talks? Stability? Our debt-to-GDP ratio is dangerously at 130% while Russia’s debt this year _reduced_ from 16.1% to 15.7% of its GDP. And Russia has announced that only “full and complete capitulation” of Ukraine will end the war and that now it is “too late” for peace talks. That’s 1945 total surrender talk.
